      local function func(self)
        local value = {}
        for item in (self .. "\n"):gmatch("(.-)\n") do
          value[#value + 1] = item
        end
        while (#value > 0) and (value[#value] == "") do
          table.remove(value)
        end
        while (#value > 0) and (value[1] == "") do
          table.remove(value, 1)
        end
        return value
      end
      local function func2(art)
        local value, value2 = func(art.art), func(art.map)
        local value3 = {}
        for item, item2 in ipairs(value) do
          local value4 = value2[item] or ""
          local value5 = {}
          local number, value6 = 1, #item2
          while number <= value6 do
            local sub = value4:sub(number, number)
            local value7 = number
            while (value7 < value6) and (value4:sub(value7 + 1, value7 + 1) == sub) do
              value7 += 1
            end
            local value8 = item2:sub(number, value7):gsub("%*", "\226\128\162")
            local item3 = value.COL[sub]
            value5[#value5 + 1] = (item3 and ("<font color=\"" .. (item3 .. ("\">" .. (value8 .. "</font>"))))) or value8
            number = value7 + 1
          end
          value3[#value3 + 1] = table.concat(value5)
        end
        return table.concat(value3, "\n"), #value
      end
      local function func3()
        if value.lbl and value.lbl.Parent then
          return value.lbl
        end
        local RegularLobby = workspace:FindFirstChild("RegularLobby")
        local value = (RegularLobby and RegularLobby:FindFirstChild("MainLobby")) and RegularLobby.MainLobby:FindFirstChild("Parts")
        if value then
          for item, item2 in ipairs(value:GetChildren()) do
            local SurfaceGui = item2:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceGui")
            local value2 = SurfaceGui and SurfaceGui:FindFirstChild("Title")
            if (value2 and value2:IsA("TextLabel")) and ((value2.Text == value.orig) or (value2.Text == value.text)) then
              return value2
            end
          end
        end
        if RegularLobby and ((os.clock() - value.lastScan) > 30) then
          value.lastScan = os.clock()
          for item3, item4 in ipairs(RegularLobby:GetDescendants()) do
            if item4:IsA("TextLabel") and ((item4.Text == value.orig) or (item4.Text == value.text)) then
              return item4
            end
          end
        end
        return nil
      end
      local function func4()
        local value = {}
        for item, item2 in ipairs(item7:GetPlayers()) do
          if item2.Character then
            value[#value + 1] = item2.Character
          end
        end
        for item3, item4 in pairs(value.parts) do
          if item4 then
            value[#value + 1] = item4
          end
        end
        return value
      end
      local function func5(arg, arg2, arg3)
        local new = RaycastParams.new()
        new.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        local value = func4()
        for index = 1, 10 do
          new.FilterDescendantsInstances = value
          local Raycast = workspace:Raycast(arg, -arg2 * 40, new)
          if not Raycast then
            return nil
          end
          local Dot = (Raycast.Position - arg):Dot(-arg2)
          if ((Raycast.Instance.Transparency < 0.9) and (Raycast.Normal:Dot(arg2) > 0.7)) and (Dot >= (arg3 or 0)) then
            return Dot
          end
          value[#value + 1] = Raycast.Instance
        end
        return nil
      end
      local function func6(Magnitude)
        Magnitude = Vector3.new(Magnitude.X, 0, Magnitude.Z)
        return ((Magnitude.Magnitude > 0.1) and Magnitude.Unit) or nil
      end
      value.PIECES[1].spot = function()
        local FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA = func3()
        local value = FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA and FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("SurfaceGui")
        local value2 = value and value.Parent
        if not (value2 and value2:IsA("BasePart")) then
          return nil
        end
        local value3 = func6(value2.CFrame.RightVector)
        if not value3 then

      function value3.hideStep(self)
        local hid = value3.hid
        if not hid then
          return
        end
        hid.a = math.clamp(hid.a + (((hid.off and -self) or self) / 0.45), 0, 1)
        local value = func15(hid.a)
        for item, item2 in pairs(hid.ltm) do
          if item.Parent then
            item.LocalTransparencyModifier = item2 + ((1 - item2) * value)
          end
        end
        if hid.off then
          if (os.clock() - hid.offAt) > 0.3 then
            value3.restoreUi(hid)
          end
          if (hid.a <= 0) and hid.back then
            value3.hideEnd()
          end
        else
          if (os.clock() - hid.scanAt) > 0.5 then
            hid.scanAt = os.clock()
            value3.hideScan(hid)
            pcall(value3.hideCam, hid)
          end
          for item3, item4 in ipairs(hid.guis) do
            if item4.Enabled then
              item4.Enabled = false
            end
          end
          for item5, item6 in ipairs(hid.fx) do
            if item6.Parent and item6.Enabled then
              item6.Enabled = false
            end
          end
        end
      end
      function value3.hideOff()
        local hid = value3.hid
        if not hid then
          return
        end
        hid.off, hid.offAt = true, os.clock()
      end
      function value3.hideEnd()

          pcall(function()

            end
          end)
        end
      end

      function value3.hudStep()
        local hrp, tagF, proot = value3.hrp, value3.tagF, value3.proot
        if not (((hrp and hrp.Parent) and tagF) and tagF.Parent) then
          return
        end
        local CurrentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not CurrentCamera then
          return
        end
        local Position = CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position
        local total = hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, value3.lift or 3, 0)
        local Magnitude = (Position - total).Magnitude
        value3.camDist = Magnitude
        if (((Magnitude > 120) and not value3.dance) and not value3.isOpen) and not proot.Visible then
          if tagF.Visible then
            tagF.Visible = false
          end
          if value3.pigTag and value3.pigTag.Visible then
            value3.pigTag.Visible = false
          end
          return
        end
        value3.hs = math.clamp(CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.Y / 1000, 0.6, 1.35)
        local clock = os.clock()
        if (clock - (value3.occAt or 0)) > 0.15 then
          value3.occAt = clock
          local new = RaycastParams.new()
          new.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
          new.FilterDescendantsInstances = func4()
          new.RespectCanCollide = false
          local total2 = total - Position
          local value = (Magnitude < 90) and workspace:Raycast(Position, total2, new)
          value3.occluded = ((value and (value.Instance.Transparency < 0.9)) and ((value.Position - Position).Magnitude < (total2.Magnitude - 0.5))) or false
        end
        local WorldToViewportPoint, WorldToViewportPoint2 = CurrentCamera:WorldToViewportPoint(total)
        local value2 = (((WorldToViewportPoint2 and (WorldToViewportPoint.Z > 0)) and (Magnitude < 80)) and not value3.occluded) and not value3.isOpen
        tagF.Visible = value2
        if value2 then
          tagF.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(WorldToViewportPoint.X + 0.5), math.floor(WorldToViewportPoint.Y + 0.5))
          value3.tagScale.Scale = math.clamp(16 / math.max(Magnitude, 1), 0.7, 1.15) * value3.hs
          local myRoot = value3.myRoot()
          local value3 = (myRoot ~= nil) and ((myRoot.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude < 20)
          value3.bub.Visible = value3 and not value3.dance
          local dance = value3.dance
          if (dance and dance.running) and not dance.ending then
            value3.lyrStep(dance.t or 0)
          elseif value3.lyrL then
            value3.lyrL.Visible = false
          end
          if value3 and not value3.dance then
            value3.bub.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, math.floor((-48 + (math.sin(clock * 2.6) * 3)) + 0.5))
            for item, item2 in ipairs(value3.dots) do
              local value4 = (math.sin((clock * 6.5) - (item * 1.1)) + 1) / 2
              local floor = math.floor((5 + (value4 * 2.5)) + 0.5)
              item2.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(floor, floor)
              item2.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45 - (value4 * 0.45)
            end
          end
        end
        local sLyrF = value3.sLyrF
        if sLyrF then
          local dance2 = value3.dance
          local value5 = (dance2 and dance2.tv) and dance2.tv.F
          local value6 = (value5 and value5.P) and value5.P.Head
          local flag = false
          if (((value6 and value6.Parent) and dance2.running) and not dance2.ending) and not value3.isOpen then
            local total3 = value6.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.7, 0)

            local Magnitude2 = (Position - total3).Magnitude
            if (WorldToViewportPoint4 and (WorldToViewportPoint3.Z > 0)) and (Magnitude2 < 80) then
              sLyrF.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(WorldToViewportPoint3.X + 0.5), math.floor(WorldToViewportPoint3.Y + 0.5))
              value3.sLyrBase.Scale = math.clamp(16 / math.max(Magnitude2, 1), 0.7, 1.15) * value3.hs
              flag = value3.lyrDraw(value3.sLyrL, value3.sLyrScale, value3.sLyrSt, dance2.t or 0, "s")
            end
          end
          if not flag and value3.sLyrL.Visible then
            value3.sLyrL.Visible = false
          end
          sLyrF.Visible = flag
        end
        local pigTag = value3.pigTag
        if pigTag then
          local dance3 = value3.dance
          local value7 = dance3 and dance3.pig
          local value8 = value7 and value7.headPos
          local flag2 = false
          if (value8 and value7.body) and value7.body.Parent then
            local total4 = value8 + Vector3.new(0, 1.05 + (0.08 * math.sin(clock * 3)), 0)
            local WorldToViewportPoint5, WorldToViewportPoint6 = CurrentCamera:WorldToViewportPoint(total4)
            local Magnitude3 = (Position - total4).Magnitude
            local value9 = value7.alpha or 1
            flag2 = (((WorldToViewportPoint6 and (WorldToViewportPoint5.Z > 0)) and (Magnitude3 < 80)) and (value9 > 0.02)) and not value3.isOpen
            if flag2 then
              local clamp = math.clamp((os.clock() - (value7.born or 0)) / 0.35, 0, 1)
              clamp = (1 + (2.70158 * ((clamp - 1) ^ 3))) + (1.70158 * ((clamp - 1) ^ 2))
              pigTag.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(WorldToViewportPoint5.X + 0.5), math.floor(WorldToViewportPoint5.Y + 0.5))
              value3.pigTagScale.Scale = math.max(0.01, (math.clamp(14 / math.max(Magnitude3, 1), 0.55, 1.1) * value3.hs) * clamp)
              value3.pigTagGrad.Offset = Vector2.new(math.sin(clock * 1.7) * 0.4, 0)
              value3.pigTagGrad.Rotation = 8 * math.sin(clock * 1.1)
              value3.pigTagLbl.TextTransparency = 1 - value9
              value3.pigTagLbl.Rotation = 3 * math.sin(clock * 2.2)
            end
          end
          pigTag.Visible = flag2
        end
        if proot.Visible then
          if value3.pShown and (clock > (value3.pAnimEnd or 0)) then
            value3.pscale.Scale = value3.hs
          end
          local total5 = (hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.2, 0)) + (CurrentCamera.CFrame.RightVector * 1.4)

          else
            proot.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-1000, -1000)
          end
        end
      end

      function value3.camShot()

        local myRoot = value3.myRoot()
        local value = (myRoot and myRoot.Position) or (total + (value3.home.LookVector * 6))
        if (value - total).Magnitude > 30 then
          value = total + (value3.home.LookVector * 6)
        end

        local Magnitude = vector3.Magnitude
        vector3 = ((Magnitude > 0.5) and vector3.Unit) or -value3.home.LookVector
        local Unit = vector3:Cross(Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)).Unit
        local clamp = math.clamp(Magnitude + 3.2, 6.5, 9)
        local total2 = ((total - (vector3 * clamp)) + (Unit * 2.2)) + Vector3.new(0, 0.45, 0)
        local new = RaycastParams.new()
        new.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        new.FilterDescendantsInstances = func4()
        local Raycast = workspace:Raycast(total, total2 - total, new)
        if Raycast then
          total2 = total + ((total2 - total).Unit * math.max(2.5, (Raycast.Position - total).Magnitude - 0.6))
        end

      end
      function value3.camStep()
        local CurrentCamera, cam = workspace.CurrentCamera, value3.cam
        if not (CurrentCamera and cam) then
          return
        end
        if cam.mode == "cut" then
          local cut = value3.cut
          if cut and cut.cf then
            CurrentCamera.CFrame = cut.cf
            CurrentCamera.FieldOfView = cut.fov
          end
          return
        end
        local clock = os.clock()
        local value = cam.shot * CFrame.Angles(math.sin(clock * 0.6) * 0.004, math.sin(clock * 0.45) * 0.006, 0)
        local value2 = cam.fov * 0.8
        if cam.mode == "in" then
          local value3 = func15((clock - cam.t0) / 0.7)
          CurrentCamera.CFrame = cam.start:Lerp(value, value3)
          CurrentCamera.FieldOfView = cam.fovStart + ((value2 - cam.fovStart) * value3)
        else
          local value4 = func15((clock - cam.t0) / 0.5)
          local home = cam.home
          local myRoot = value3.myRoot()
          if not myRoot or (cam.me0 and ((myRoot.Position - cam.me0).Magnitude > 40)) then
            value3.camEnd()
            return
          end
          if cam.me0 then
            home = home + (myRoot.Position - cam.me0)
          end
          CurrentCamera.CFrame = cam.start:Lerp(home, value4)
          CurrentCamera.FieldOfView = cam.fovStart + ((cam.fov - cam.fovStart) * value4)
          if value4 >= 1 then
            value3.camEnd()
          end
        end
      end
      function value3.camEnd()
        local cam = value3.cam
        value3.cam = nil

              CurrentCamera.CameraType = cam.ctype
            end
          end)
        end
      end
      function value3.camOn()
        local CurrentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not CurrentCamera then
          return
        end
        local cam = value3.cam
        if not cam then
          if CurrentCamera.CameraType ~= Enum.CameraType.Custom then
            return
          end
          local myRoot = value3.myRoot()
          cam = {fov = CurrentCamera.FieldOfView, ctype = CurrentCamera.CameraType, home = func18(CurrentCamera.CFrame), me0 = myRoot and myRoot.Position}
          value3.cam = cam
        end
        local value, value2 = pcall(value3.camShot)
        if not value then
          value3.camEnd()
          return
        end
        cam.shot, cam.start, cam.fovStart = value2, func18(CurrentCamera.CFrame), CurrentCamera.FieldOfView
        cam.mode, cam.t0 = "in", os.clock()
        CurrentCamera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
        pcall(function()
          RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("PulseNpcCam")
        end)
        RunService:BindToRenderStep("PulseNpcCam", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 2, function()
          pcall(value3.camStep)
        end)
      end

      function value3.cutShot(arg, arg2, arg3)
        local item = value3.CUT.shots[arg]
        local item2 = item[1]
        local value = (value3.CUT.shots[arg + 1] and value3.CUT.shots[arg + 1][1]) or value3.CUT.len
        local clamp = math.clamp((arg2 - item2) / math.max(0.1, value - item2), 0, 1)
        local clamp2 = math.clamp(arg2 - item2, 0, 10)
        local T, A, d, r, vector3 = arg3.T, arg3.A, arg3.d, arg3.r, Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        local item3 = item[2]
        local value2, value3, number, number2 = nil, nil, 44, 0
        if (item3 == "wide") or (item3 == "wide2") then
          local value4 = (T + A) / 2
          local value5 = ((item3 == "wide") and 7.4) or 6
          value2 = ((value4 + (r * value5)) + (vector3 * 0.7)) + (d * ((((item3 == "wide") and -1.2) or 0.8) + ((((item3 == "wide") and 2.4) or -1.4) * clamp)))
          value3 = value4 - (vector3 * 0.35)
          number = ((item3 == "wide") and 50) or (46 - (6 * clamp))
        elseif (item3 == "tOTS") or (item3 == "tOTS2") then
          local equal = item3 == "tOTS"
          value2 = ((A + (d * ((equal and 3.2) or 2.8))) + (r * ((equal and 2.8) or 2.5))) + (vector3 * ((equal and 0.85) or 0.6))
          value2 = value2 + ((T - value2) * (((equal and 0.1) or 0.2) * clamp))
          value3 = (T + (r * 0.35)) - (vector3 * 0.2)
          number = (equal and 40) or 36
        elseif item3 == "tClose" then
          value2 = ((T + (d * (4.4 - (0.9 * clamp)))) + (r * 0.9)) + (vector3 * 0.1)
          value3 = T - (vector3 * 0.2)
          number = 40
        elseif item3 == "tLow" then
          local total = -0.3 + (0.6 * clamp)
          value2 = (T + (((d * math.cos(total)) + (r * math.sin(total))) * 3.7)) - (vector3 * 1.35)
          value3 = T + (vector3 * 0.2)
          number = 48
        elseif item3 == "mClose" then
          value2 = ((A - (d * 3.4)) + (r * 1.7)) + (vector3 * 0.55)
          value3 = A - (vector3 * 0.2)
          number = 40 - (4 * clamp)
          number2 = ((arg2 >= 9.14) and (math.exp(-(arg2 - 9.14) * 7) * 0.02)) or 0
        elseif item3 == "mPunch" then
          value2 = ((A - (d * 3.2)) + (r * 1.3)) + (vector3 * 0.5)
          value3 = A - (vector3 * 0.1)
          number = 62 - (22 * math.min(1, clamp2 / 0.12))
          number2 = math.exp(-clamp2 * 6) * 0.03
        elseif item3 == "mOTS" then
          value2 = ((T - (d * 2.6)) + (r * 3)) + (vector3 * 1)
          value2 = value2 + ((A - value2) * (0.14 * clamp))
          value3 = (A - (r * 0.35)) - (vector3 * 0.3)
          number = 40 - (((arg2 >= 17.7) and (5 * math.min(1, (arg2 - 17.7) / 1.5))) or 0)
        elseif item3 == "tECU" then
          value2 = (T + (d * 3)) + (r * 0.25)
          value3 = T - (vector3 * 0.1)
          number = 34
          number2 = 0.012
        elseif item3 == "tPunch" then
          value2 = (T + (d * 3.1)) + (vector3 * 0.04)
          value3 = T - (vector3 * 0.08)
          number = (52 - (18 * math.min(1, clamp2 / 0.09))) + (((arg2 >= 22.86) and (-7 * math.min(1, (arg2 - 22.86) / 0.08))) or 0)
          number2 = (math.exp(-clamp2 * 3) * 0.035) + (((arg2 >= 22.86) and (math.exp(-(arg2 - 22.86) * 4) * 0.04)) or 0)
        end

        if arg3.rp then

          local Raycast = workspace:Raycast(value3, total2, arg3.rp)

            lookAt = CFrame.lookAt(value3 + (total2.Unit * max), value3)

      end
      function value3.cutCam(self)
        local G2 = value3.cut.G
        local shots = value3.CUT.shots
        local number = 1
        for index = 1, #shots do
          if self >= shots[index][1] then
            number = index
          end
        end
        local cutShot, cutShot2 = value3.cutShot(number, self, G2)
        local item = shots[number][3]
        if (item and (number > 1)) and ((self - shots[number][1]) < item) then
          local cutShot3, cutShot4 = value3.cutShot(number - 1, self, G2)
          local value = func15((self - shots[number][1]) / item)
          cutShot, cutShot2 = cutShot3:Lerp(cutShot, value), cutShot4 + ((cutShot2 - cutShot4) * value)
        end
        local CUT = value3.CUT
        local total = CUT.phase + (math.floor((self - CUT.phase) / CUT.period) * CUT.period)
        local value2 = ((self >= 0) and math.exp(-(self - total) * 10)) or 0
        value3.cut.beat = value2
        cutShot2 = cutShot2 * (1 - (value2 * (((self > 20) and 0.05) or 0.028)))
        return cutShot, cutShot2
      end
      function value3.cutStep()
        local cut = value3.cut
        if not cut then
          return
        end
        local value = (cut.running and (os.clock() - cut.t0)) or 0
        local CUT = value3.CUT
        if cut.running then
          while (cut.ai <= #CUT.tA) and (CUT.tA[cut.ai][1] <= value) do
            local value2 = value3.cutT and value3.cutT[CUT.tA[cut.ai][2]]
            if value2 then
              if cut.tCur and (cut.tCur ~= value2) then
                pcall(function()
                  cut.tCur:Stop(0.25)
                end)
              end
              pcall(function()
                value2:Play(0.15)
              end)
              cut.tCur = value2
            end
            cut.ai += 1
          end
          while (cut.mi <= #CUT.mA) and (CUT.mA[cut.mi][1] <= value) do
            local item = cut.mAn[CUT.mA[cut.mi][2]]
            if item then
              if cut.mCur and (cut.mCur ~= item) then
                pcall(function()
                  cut.mCur:Stop(0.25)
                end)
              end
              pcall(function()
                item:Play(0.15)
              end)
              cut.mCur = item
            end
            cut.mi += 1
          end
          while (cut.fi <= #CUT.flash) and (CUT.flash[cut.fi][1] <= value) do
            value3.flash.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - CUT.flash[cut.fi][2]
            func16(value3.flash, 0.4, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
            cut.fi += 1
          end
          local item2 = CUT.lines[cut.li]
          while item2 and (value >= (item2.w[1][1] - 0.06)) do
            value3.cutLine(cut, item2)
            cut.li += 1
            item2 = CUT.lines[cut.li]
          end
          local flag, flag2 = false, false
          for item3, item4 in ipairs(CUT.lines) do
            if (value >= item4.w[1][1]) and (value <= (item4.w[#item4.w][1] + 0.5)) then
              if item4.who == "t" then
                flag = true
              else
                flag2 = true
              end
            end
          end
          value3.talking, value3.actorTalking = flag, flag2
        end
        local cutCam, cutCam2 = value3.cutCam(value)
        cut.cf, cut.fov = cutCam, cutCam2
        local line = cut.line
        local total = 1 + ((cut.beat or 0) * 0.07)
        local value3 = ((line and (value > line.t1)) and math.clamp((value - line.t1) / 0.2, 0, 1)) or 0
        for item5, item6 in ipairs(cut.words) do
          local total2 = value - item6.t
          if total2 < 0 then
            item6.l.TextTransparency, item6.l.TextStrokeTransparency, item6.st.Transparency, item6.sh.TextTransparency = 1, 1, 1, 1
          else
            local min = math.min(1, total2 / 0.24)
            local value4 = math.min(1, total2 / 0.1) * (1 - value3)
            item6.s.Scale = ((0.3 + (0.7 * func19(min))) * total) * (1 - (0.2 * value3))
            item6.l.TextTransparency = 1 - value4
            item6.l.TextStrokeTransparency = 1 - (value4 * 0.6)
            item6.st.Transparency = 1 - (value4 * 0.75)
            item6.l.Rotation = (item6.rot * (1 - min)) + ((line.wob and (math.sin((value * 15) + (item6.i * 1.7)) * 7)) or 0)
            local floor = math.floor((((1 - min) * 16) - (value3 * 12)) + 0.5)
            item6.l.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, floor)
            item6.ss.Scale = item6.s.Scale
            item6.sh.Rotation = item6.l.Rotation
            item6.sh.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 3, 0.5, floor + 4)
            item6.sh.TextTransparency = 1 - (value4 * 0.55)
          end
        end
        local value5 = (cut.whoAt and (os.clock() - cut.whoAt)) or 1
        local value6 = (cut.line and (1 - value3)) or 0
        value3.who.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - value6
        value3.who.TextTransparency = 1 - value6
        value3.who.Rotation = (1 - math.min(1, value5 / 0.2)) * -6
        if cut.running and (value >= CUT.len) then
          value3.cutEnd(false)
        end
      end

      function value3.songReady(data)
        if data.data and not data.asset then
          return false
        end
        for item, item2 in ipairs(data.tracks or {}) do
          if not item2.asset then
            return false
          end
        end
        return true
      end
      function value3.prepSongs()
        if value3.prepBusy then
          return
        end
        value3.prepBusy = true
        task.spawn(function()
          for item, item2 in ipairs(value3.SONGS) do
            if item2.data and not item2.asset then
              pcall(value3.trackAsset, item2)
            end
            for item3, item4 in ipairs(item2.tracks or {}) do
              if not item4.asset then
                item4.asset = value3.fileAsset(item4.file, item4.data)
              end
            end
          end
          if not value3.tvNoise then
            value3.tvNoise = value3.fileAsset("PulseHub/tv_noise_v1.png", value3.TVNOISE)
          end
          value3.prepBusy = false
        end)
      end
      function value3.trackAsset(asset)
        if asset.asset then
          return asset.asset
        end
        if not asset.data then
          return false
        end
        asset.asset = value3.fileAsset(asset.file, asset.data)
        return asset.asset or false
      end
      function value3.joints()
        if value3.jm and (value3.jmModel == value3.model) then
          return value3.jm
        end
        local value = {}
        for item, item2 in ipairs((value3.model and value3.model:GetDescendants()) or {}) do
          if item2:IsA("AnimationConstraint") or item2:IsA("Motor6D") then
            value[item2.Name] = item2
          end
        end
        value3.jm, value3.jmModel = value, value3.model
        return value
      end
      local function func20(self)
        self = math.clamp(self, 0, 1)
        return (self * self) * (3 - (2 * self))
      end
      local function func21(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5)
        arg4, arg5 = arg4 or 0.12, arg5 or 0.15
        if (arg <= (arg2 - arg4)) or (arg >= (arg3 + arg5)) then
          return 0
        end
        if arg < arg2 then
          return func20(((arg - arg2) + arg4) / arg4)
        end
        if arg > arg3 then
          return 1 - func20((arg - arg3) / arg5)
        end
        return 1
      end

      function value3.shake(arg, arg2, arg3)
        local myRoot = value3.myRoot()
        if (not myRoot or value3.cut) or value3.isOpen then
          return
        end
        local value = arg2 * math.clamp(1 - ((myRoot.Position - arg).Magnitude / 75), 0, 1)
        if value < 0.03 then
          return
        end
        value3.shk = {t0 = os.clock(), dur = arg3, mag = value}
        if value3.shkBound then
          return
        end
        value3.shkBound = true
        pcall(function()
          RunService:BindToRenderStep("PulseFightShake", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function()
            local shk = value3.shk
            local CurrentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera
            if not (shk and CurrentCamera) or (CurrentCamera.CameraType ~= Enum.CameraType.Custom) then
              return
            end
            local total = os.clock() - shk.t0
            if total > shk.dur then
              value3.shk = nil
              return
            end
            local value = shk.mag * ((1 - (total / shk.dur)) ^ 2)
            CurrentCamera.CFrame = CurrentCamera.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(((math.random() - 0.5) * 2.4) * value), math.rad(((math.random() - 0.5) * 2.4) * value), math.rad(((math.random() - 0.5) * 1.2) * value))
          end)
        end)
      end
      function value3.statueFind()
        local RegularLobby = workspace:FindFirstChild("RegularLobby")
        local value = RegularLobby and RegularLobby:FindFirstChild("MainLobby")
        local value2 = value and value:FindFirstChild("Models")
        if not (value2 and value3.hrp) then
          return nil
        end
        local value3, value4
        for item, item2 in ipairs(value2:GetChildren()) do
          local value5 = item2:IsA("Model") and item2:FindFirstChild("Torso")
          if ((((value5 and item2:FindFirstChild("Head")) and item2:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")) and item2:FindFirstChild("Left Arm")) and item2:FindFirstChild("Right Leg")) and item2:FindFirstChild("Left Leg") then
            local Magnitude = (value5.Position - value3.hrp.Position).Magnitude
            if (Magnitude < 90) and (not value4 or (Magnitude < value4)) then
              value3, value4 = item2, Magnitude
            end
          end
        end
        if not value3 then
          return nil
        end
        local value6
        local Parts = value:FindFirstChild("Parts")
        if Parts then
          local RightArm = value3["Right Arm"]
          for item3, item4 in ipairs(Parts:GetChildren()) do
            if (item4:IsA("BasePart") and (item4.Name == "Handle")) and ((item4.Position - RightArm.Position).Magnitude < 4) then
              value6 = item4
            end
          end
        end
        return value3, value6
      end

      function value3.fightBuild(fight)
        local statueFind, statueFind2 = value3.statueFind()
        if not statueFind then
          return false
        end
        local total = value3.home.Position.Y - (value3.hum.HipHeight + (value3.hrp.Size.Y / 2))
        local Position = value3.home.Position
        local Position2 = statueFind.Torso.Position
        local vector3 = Vector3.new(Position2.X - Position.X, 0, Position2.Z - Position.Z)
        if vector3.Magnitude < 12 then
          return false
        end
        vector3 = vector3.Unit
        local value = {
          src = statueFind,
          knifeSrc = statueFind2,
          hidden = {},
          fired = {},
          dir = vector3,
          floor = total,
          T0 = Position,
          sp = {}
        }
        if not value3.statueClone(value) then
          return false
        end
        local new = RaycastParams.new()
        new.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        new.FilterDescendantsInstances = func4()
        local total2 = Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.6, 0)
        local Raycast = workspace:Raycast(total2, -vector3 * 14, new)
        local value2 = (Raycast and (Raycast.Position - total2).Magnitude) or nil
        if value2 and (value2 > 2.5) then
          value.K = Position - (vector3 * (value2 - 1.05))
          value.wall = Raycast.Position
        else
          value.K = Position - (vector3 * 6)
        end
        value.L = Position + (vector3 * 8.5)
        value.A = Position + (vector3 * 3)
        value.S2 = value.A + (vector3 * 1.8)
        value.B = value.S2 - (vector3 * 2.7)
        local Unit = vector3:Cross(Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)).Unit
        local number = 1
        local Raycast2 = workspace:Raycast(value.S2, Unit * 14, new)
        local Raycast3 = workspace:Raycast(value.S2, -Unit * 14, new)
        if ((Raycast3 and (Raycast3.Position - value.S2).Magnitude) or 14) > ((Raycast2 and (Raycast2.Position - value.S2).Magnitude) or 14) then
          number = -1
        end
        value.side = Unit * number
        value.torsoH = 3
        fight.fight = value
        value3.fsnd("crack", value.P.Torso, 1.2)
        return true
      end
      function value3.statueClone(hidden)

      function value3.fightFree(fight)
        local value = fight and fight.fight
        if not value then
          return
        end
        fight.fight = nil
        for item, item2 in ipairs(value.hidden or {}) do
          pcall(function()
            if item2[1].Parent then
              item2[1].LocalTransparencyModifier = item2[2]
            end
          end)
        end
        pcall(function()
          value.model:Destroy()
        end)
        if value.pig then
          pcall(function()
            value.pig.model:Destroy()
          end)
        end
        for item3, item4 in ipairs({"stars", "charge"}) do
          pcall(function()
            if value[item4] then
              value[item4]:Destroy()
            end
          end)
        end
        value.parts.PulseStatue, value.parts.PulsePig = nil, nil
        value3.shk = nil
        pcall(function()
          RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("PulseFightShake")
        end)
        value3.shkBound = false
      end
      local function func25(arg, arg2, arg3)

        end
        return value
      end

      function value3.danceStep(self)

      function value3.step(self)

          if value then

            if (vector3.Magnitude > 0.5) and (vector3.Magnitude < 60) then
              dance.base = dance.base:Lerp(CFrame.lookAt(Position, Position + vector3.Unit), math.clamp(self * 2, 0, 1))

            Position2 = CFrame.lookAt(Position3, Position3 + vector32.Unit)
          end
        end
        local value3 = hrp.CFrame
        if value3 ~= Position2 then
          if (((value3.Position - Position2.Position).Magnitude < 0.001) and (value3.LookVector:Dot(Position2.LookVector) > 0.999999)) and (value3.UpVector:Dot(Position2.UpVector) > 0.999999) then
            hrp.CFrame = Position2
          else
            hrp.CFrame = value3:Lerp(Position2, math.clamp(self * 7, 0, 1))
          end
        end
        local look = value3.anims.look
        if ((not value3.isOpen and look) and not look.IsPlaying) and (os.clock() > (value3.nextLook or 0)) then
          value3.nextLook = (os.clock() + 7) + (math.random() * 6)

        end
      end

          function value16.drive(self)
            local links = value16.links
            local HumanoidRootPart = PulseFC(self, "HumanoidRootPart")
            local HumanoidRootPart2 = PulseFC(value16.model, "HumanoidRootPart")
            if not ((links and HumanoidRootPart) and HumanoidRootPart2) then
              return false
            end
            local k = value16.k
            for index = 1, #links do
              local item = links[index]
              local g = item.g
              local value, Inverse
              if g.motor then
                value, Inverse = g.j.C0, g.j.C1
              else
                value, Inverse = g.a0.CFrame, g.a1.CFrame
              end
              local value2 = (value * g.j.Transform) * Inverse:Inverse()
              local value3
              if item.root then
                value3 = CFrame.new(item.restC.Position + ((value2.Position - item.restG.Position) * k)) * value2.Rotation
              else
                value3 = (item.pivot0 * value2.Rotation) * item.pivot1
              end
              item.relG, item.relC = value2, value3
              item.c.j.Transform = (item.c0inv * value3) * item.c1
            end
            local lift = value16.lift
            if #value16.feet > 0 then
              local huge, huge2 = math.huge, math.huge
              for item2, item3 in ipairs(value16.feet) do
                local identity, identity2 = CFrame.identity, CFrame.identity
                for item4, item5 in ipairs(item3.list) do
                  identity = identity * links[item5].relG
                  identity2 = identity2 * links[item5].relC
                end
                huge = math.min(huge, identity.Y - item3.gh)
                huge2 = math.min(huge2, identity2.Y - item3.ch)
              end
              if (huge < math.huge) and (huge2 < math.huge) then
                lift = huge - huge2
              end
            end
            local value4 = HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, lift, 0)
            HumanoidRootPart2.CFrame = value4
            value16.rootCF, value16.hrpCF = value4, HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
            return true
          end
          function value16.pose(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4)
            if not (arg and arg4) then
              return false
            end
            local restC
            for index = 1, #arg do
              local item = arg[index]
              local value
              if item.root then
                value = item.restC
                restC = item
              else
                local Parent, Parent2 = arg2(item.g.p0), arg2(item.g.p1)
                if ((Parent and Parent2) and Parent.Parent) and Parent2.Parent then
                  value = (item.pivot0 * (Parent.CFrame:Inverse() * Parent2.CFrame).Rotation) * item.pivot1
                else
                  value = item.restC
                end
              end
              local value2 = (arg3 and arg3[item.c.p1.Name]) or item.c
              if value2 then
                value2.j.Transform = (item.c0inv * value) * item.c1
              end
              if not arg3 then
                item.relC = value
              end
            end
            local value3 = restC and arg2(restC.g.p1)
            if not (value3 and value3.Parent) then
              return false
            end
            arg4.CFrame = value3.CFrame * restC.restC:Inverse()
            return true
          end

          function value16.corpseStep()
            for item, item2 in pairs(value16.corpses) do
              if not item.Parent or not item2.model.Parent then
                value16.corpseFree(item2)
                value16.corpses[item] = nil
              else
                local clock = os.clock()
                if (item2.dirty ~= false) or ((clock - (item2.scanAt or 0)) > 1) then
                  item2.dirty, item2.scanAt = false, clock
                  if not item2.watch then
                    item2.watch = item.DescendantAdded:Connect(function()
                      item2.dirty = true
                    end)
                  end
                  for item3, item4 in ipairs(item:GetDescendants()) do
                    if value16.isA(item4, "BasePart") or value16.isA(item4, "Decal") then
                      if item4.LocalTransparencyModifier ~= 1 then
                        item4.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
                      end
                      if not item2.seen[item4] then
                        item2.seen[item4] = true
                        item2.hidden[#item2.hidden + 1] = item4
                      end
                    end
                  end
                end
                local LowerTorso = item2.map.LowerTorso
                if not item2.done then
                  value16.pose(item2.links, function(Name)
                    return item2.map[Name.Name]
                  end, item2.joints, item2.root)
                  if (LowerTorso and LowerTorso.Anchored) and ((os.clock() - item2.t0) > 5) then
                    item2.done = true
                  end
                end
                local fadeOf = value16.fadeOf(item2.hidden)
                if fadeOf ~= item2.fade then
                  item2.fade = fadeOf
                  for item5, item6 in ipairs(item2.parts) do
                    if item6.Parent then

                    end
                  end
                end
              end
            end

          function value16.mountScanOf(mountList, arg)
            local value, value2 = {}, {}
            local value3 = {LowerTorso = PulseFC(arg, "LowerTorso"), UpperTorso = PulseFC(arg, "UpperTorso")}
            local function func(self)
              if self == nil then
                return nil
              end
              for item, item2 in pairs(value3) do
                if item2 == self then
                  return item
                end
              end
              return nil
            end
            local WeaponDisplays = workspace:FindFirstChild("WeaponDisplays")
            if WeaponDisplays then
              for item, item2 in ipairs(WeaponDisplays:GetChildren()) do
                local RigidConstraint = item2:FindFirstChildOfClass("RigidConstraint")
                local value4 = RigidConstraint and RigidConstraint.Attachment0
                local value5 = value4 and func(value4.Parent)
                if value5 and not value2[value4] then
                  value2[value4] = true
                  value[#value + 1] = {inst = value4, prop = "CFrame", part = value5}
                end
                local PulseMount = item2:FindFirstChild("PulseMount")
                local value6 = (PulseMount and value16.isA(PulseMount, "JointInstance")) and func(PulseMount.Part0)
                if value6 and not value2[PulseMount] then
                  value2[PulseMount] = true
                  value[#value + 1] = {inst = PulseMount, prop = "C0", part = value6, anchor = PulseMount:GetAttribute("PulseAnchor")}
                end
              end
            end
            mountList.mountList, mountList.mountCh, mountList.mountAt = value, arg, os.clock()
          end
          local function func(arg, arg2, arg3)
            local abs = math.abs(arg)
            local min = math.min(abs, arg2)
            local total = (((arg2 > 0.001) and ((min * arg3) / arg2)) or 0) + math.max(abs - arg2, 0)
            return ((arg < 0) and -total) or total
          end
          function value16.mountFollowOf(mounts, arg, arg2, arg3)
            if (mounts.mountCh ~= arg) or ((os.clock() - (mounts.mountAt or 0)) > 0.5) then
              value16.mountScanOf(mounts, arg)
            end
            local mountList = mounts.mountList
            if not ((mountList and (#mountList > 0)) and arg2) then
              return
            end
            mounts.mounts = mounts.mounts or {}
            local value = {}
            local function func(self)

          function value17.drive(framesAt, arg)
            local links = framesAt.links
            local HumanoidRootPart = PulseFC(arg, "HumanoidRootPart")
            local HumanoidRootPart2 = PulseFC(framesAt.model, "HumanoidRootPart")
            if not ((links and HumanoidRootPart) and HumanoidRootPart2) then
              return false
            end
            local k = framesAt.k
            local clock = os.clock()
            local count = (clock - (framesAt.framesAt or 0)) > 1
            if count then
              framesAt.framesAt = clock
            end
            for index = 1, #links do
              local item = links[index]
              local g = item.g
              if count or not item.g0 then
                local value, Inverse
                if g.motor then
                  value, Inverse = g.j.C0, g.j.C1
                else
                  value, Inverse = g.a0.CFrame, g.a1.CFrame
                end
                item.g0, item.g1inv = value, Inverse:Inverse()
              end
              local value2 = (item.g0 * g.j.Transform) * item.g1inv
              local value3
              if item.root then
                value3 = CFrame.new(item.restC.Position + ((value2.Position - item.restG.Position) * k)) * value2.Rotation
              else
                value3 = (item.pivot0 * value2.Rotation) * item.pivot1
              end
              item.relG, item.relC = value2, value3
              item.c.j.Transform = (item.c0inv * value3) * item.c1
            end

            if #framesAt.feet > 0 then

          value.grab()
          return
        end
        value.toLobby()
        value.state = "Surviving"
      end
      function value.step()
        local on = value.on
        if not (((on.inno or on.sheriff) or on.murder) or on.exp) then
          value.state, value.role = "Off", nil
          value.hold(false)
          return
        end
        value.hook()
        local mine, mine2 = value.mine()
        value.role = mine
        if not mine or not value.alive() then
          value.state = "Waiting"
          value.hold(false)
          if not mine then
            table.clear(value.seen)
          end
          return
        end
        value.count(mine2)
        local lower = mine:lower()
        if lower:find("murder") then
          if on.murder or on.exp then
            value.hold(true)
            value.state = "Killing"
            value.stabAll(mine2)
            return

          if item2.Name == "PulseESPModels" then
            pcall(function()
              item2:Destroy()
            end)
          end
        end
        value3.modelFolder = value2.make("Folder", {Name = "PulseESPModels"}, CurrentCamera)
        return value3.modelFolder
      end
      value2.poolFor = function(arg, arg2)
        value3.pool = value3.pool or setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
        local item = value3.pool[arg]
        if not item then
          item = {}
          value3.pool[arg] = item
        end
        local item2 = item[arg2]
        if not item2 then
          item2 = {at = os.clock(), items = {}}
          item[arg2] = item2
        end
        return item2
      end
      value2.poolKey = function(ClassName)
        local Size = ClassName.Size
        local text = ClassName.Name .. ("|" .. (ClassName.ClassName .. ("|" .. string.format("%.3f,%.3f,%.3f", Size.X, Size.Y, Size.Z))))
        if ClassName.ClassName == "MeshPart" then
          text = text .. ("|" .. tostring(ClassName.MeshId))
        else
          local SpecialMesh = ClassName:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpecialMesh")
          if SpecialMesh then
            local Scale = SpecialMesh.Scale
            text = text .. ("|" .. (tostring(SpecialMesh.MeshId) .. ("|" .. (SpecialMesh.MeshType.Name .. ("|" .. string.format("%.3f,%.3f,%.3f", Scale.X, Scale.Y, Scale.Z))))))
          end
        end
        return text
      end
      value2.poolPurge = function(self)
        if not value3.pool then
          return
        end
        for item, item2 in pairs(value3.pool) do
          for item3, item4 in pairs(item2) do
            if (self == nil) or (item3 == self) then
              for item5, item6 in pairs(item4.items) do
                for item7, item8 in ipairs(item6) do
                  pcall(function()
                    item8:Destroy()
                  end)
                end
              end
              item2[item3] = nil
            end
          end
        end
      end
      value2.poolSweep = function()
        if not value3.pool then
          return
        end
        local clock = os.clock()
        for item, item2 in pairs(value3.pool) do
          for item3, item4 in pairs(item2) do
            local value = (type(item3) ~= "table") and (item3.Parent == nil)
            if value or ((clock - item4.at) > 45) then
              for item5, item6 in pairs(item4.items) do
                for item7, item8 in ipairs(item6) do
                  pcall(function()
                    item8:Destroy()
                  end)
                end
              end
              item2[item3] = nil
            end
          end
        end
      end
      value2.modelDropIn = function(arg, arg2)
        local item = arg[arg2]
        if item then
          for item2, item3 in ipairs(item.conns or {}) do
            pcall(function()
              item3:Disconnect()
            end)
          end
          local value = (((item.kind ~= "Wireframe") and item.keys) and value2.poolFor(arg, arg2)) or nil
          for item4, item5 in ipairs(item.clones) do
            local value2 = value and item.keys[item4]
            if value2 and (item5.Parent ~= nil) then
              pcall(function()
                item5.Transparency = 1
              end)
              local item6 = value.items[value2]
              if not item6 then
                item6 = {}
                value.items[value2] = item6
              end
              item6[#item6 + 1] = item5
            else
              pcall(function()
                item5:Destroy()
              end)
            end
          end
          if value then
            value.at = os.clock()
          end
        end
        arg[arg2] = nil
      end
      value2.modelDrop = function(self)
        value2.modelDropIn(value3.models, self)
        value2.modelDropIn(value3.halos, self)
      end
      value2.cloneable = function(ClassName)
        local partKinds = value3.partKinds
        local ClassName2 = ClassName.ClassName
        local item = partKinds[ClassName2]
        if item == nil then
          item = ClassName:IsA("BasePart")
          partKinds[ClassName2] = item
        end
        if not item or (ClassName.Name == "HumanoidRootPart") then
          return false
        end
        if (ClassName.Transparency >= 0.95) or (ClassName.LocalTransparencyModifier >= 0.95) then
          return false
        end
        if ClassName:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("WrapLayer") then
          return false
        end
        local Accessory = ClassName:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Accessory")
        if Accessory and Accessory:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("WrapLayer", true) then
          return false
        end
        return true
      end
      value2.modelBroken = function(char)
        return char.char.Parent == nil
      end
      value2.modelBuild = function(FindFirstChild, arg, arg2, arg3, items)
        local value = tostring(arg):match("^[^@]+")
        local value2 = {
          material = arg,
          kind = value,
          spec = arg2,
          char = FindFirstChild,
          root = (FindFirstChild:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or FindFirstChild:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")) or FindFirstChild:FindFirstChild("Torso"),
          sources = {},
          clones = {},
          sizes = {},
          meshes = {},
          scales = {},
          cfs = {},
          boxes = {},
          keys = {},
          shown = nil,
          scale = 1,
          conns = {}
        }
        if value == "Wireframe" then
          items = nil
        end
        for item, item2 in ipairs(FindFirstChild:GetDescendants()) do
          if value2.cloneable(item2) then
            local value3 = (items and value2.poolKey(item2)) or nil
            local value4 = value3 and items.items[value3]
            local value5 = value4 and table.remove(value4)
            while value5 and (value5.Parent ~= arg3) do
              pcall(function()
                value5:Destroy()
              end)
              value5 = table.remove(value4)
            end
            local Scale, value6
            if value5 then
              Scale = value5:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpecialMesh")
              if Scale then
                local SpecialMesh = item2:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpecialMesh")
                value6 = (SpecialMesh and SpecialMesh.Scale) or Scale.Scale
              end
            else
              local Archivable = item2.Archivable
              item2.Archivable = true
              local value7, value8 = pcall(function()
                return item2:Clone()
              end)
              item2.Archivable = Archivable
              if value7 and value8 then
                value5 = value8
                if value5:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpecialMesh") then
                  for item3, item4 in ipairs(value5:GetChildren()) do
                    if item4:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
                      Scale = item4
                      item4.TextureId = ""
                    else
                      item4:Destroy()
                    end
                  end
                else
                  value5:ClearAllChildren()
                end
                if Scale then
                  value6 = Scale.Scale
                end
                if value5:IsA("MeshPart") then
                  pcall(function()
                    value5.TextureID = ""
                  end)
                end
                value5.Name = "M"
              end
            end
            if value5 then
              local total = #value2.clones + 1
              if Scale and (Scale.MeshType == Enum.MeshType.FileMesh) then
                value2.meshes[total], value2.scales[total] = Scale, value6 * arg2[2]
                Scale.Scale = value2.scales[total]
              else
                value2.sizes[total] = item2.Size * arg2[2]
                value5.Size = value2.sizes[total]
              end
              value5.Anchored, value5.CanCollide, value5.CanQuery, value5.CanTouch, value5.CastShadow = true, false, false, false, false
              value5.Material, value5.Reflectance, value5.Transparency = arg2[1], arg2[4], 1
              if ((value == "Wireframe") and (item2.Parent == FindFirstChild)) and (item2.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart") then
                value2.boxes[total] = value2.make("SelectionBox", {Adornee = value5, LineThickness = 0.02, SurfaceTransparency = 1, Transparency = 1}, value5)
              end
              if value5.Parent ~= arg3 then
                value5.Parent = arg3
              end
              value2.sources[total], value2.clones[total], value2.keys[total] = item2, value5, value3
            end
          end
        end
        local function func(IsA)
          if ((IsA:IsA("BasePart") or IsA:IsA("Accessory")) or IsA:IsA("WrapLayer")) or IsA:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
            if not value2.dirty then
              value2.dirty = os.clock()
            end
          end
        end
        value2.conns[1] = FindFirstChild.DescendantAdded:Connect(func)
        value2.conns[2] = FindFirstChild.DescendantRemoving:Connect(func)
        return value2
      end
      value2.modelResize = function(scale, arg)
        scale.scale = arg
        for item, item2 in ipairs(scale.clones) do
          local item3 = scale.meshes[item]
          if item3 then
            item3.Scale = scale.scales[item] * arg
          else
            item2.Size = scale.sizes[item] * arg
          end
        end
        for item4, item5 in pairs(scale.boxes) do
          item5.LineThickness = 0.02 * arg
        end
      end
      value2.modelPaint = function(clones, arg, arg2, arg3)
        local clones2, sources = clones.clones, clones.sources
        local value = clones.kind or clones.material
        local value2 = value2.chamsSpeed or 1
        local root = clones.root
        local value3 = ((root and root.Parent) and root.Position.Y) or 0
        local value4, Lerp
        if value == "Gradient" then
          value4, Lerp = value2.chamTone(value2.tone(value2.chamsGradA)), value2.chamTone(value2.tone(value2.chamsGradB))
        end
        for index = 1, #clones2 do
          local item = clones2[index]
          local value5 = arg
          if value == "Iridescent" then
            value5 = Color3.fromHSV((((arg3 * 0.12) * value2) + (index * 0.012)) % 1, 0.38, 1)
          elseif value == "Gradient" then
            local item2 = sources[index]
            local number = 0.5
            if item2 and item2.Parent then
              number = math.clamp((item2.Position.Y - (value3 - 3)) / 5.6, 0, 1)
            end
            if value2.chamsGradScroll then
              number = math.abs((((number + ((arg3 * 0.2) * value2)) % 1) * 2) - 1)
            end
            value5 = Lerp:Lerp(value4, number)
          end
          item.Color = value5
          item.Transparency = arg2
        end
      end
      value2.modelShow = function(shown, arg, arg2, arg3)
        if not arg then
          if shown.shown ~= false then
            for item, item2 in ipairs(shown.clones) do
              item2.Transparency = 1
            end
            for item3, item4 in pairs(shown.boxes) do
              item4.Transparency = 1
            end
            shown.shown = false
          end
          return
        end
        local clock = os.clock()
        local equal = shown.shown == true
        if equal and ((clock - (shown.propsAt or 0)) < 0.03333333333333333) then
          return
        end
        local total = 1 - math.clamp(shown.spec[3] * arg3, 0, 1)
        local value = shown.kind or shown.material
        shown.propsAt = clock
        if value == "Wireframe" then
          shown.shown = true
          if (not equal or (shown.lastTint ~= arg2)) or (math.abs((shown.lastTr or -1) - total) >= 0.01) then
            shown.lastTint, shown.lastTr = arg2, total
            for item5, item6 in pairs(shown.boxes) do
              item6.Color3 = arg2
              item6.Transparency = total
            end
          end
          return
        end
        if (value == "Iridescent") or (value == "Gradient") then
          shown.shown = true
          shown.lastTint, shown.lastTr = nil, nil
          value2.modelPaint(shown, arg2, total, clock)
          return
        end
        local value2 = not equal or (shown.lastTint ~= arg2)
        local value3 = not equal or (math.abs((shown.lastTr or -1) - total) >= 0.01)
        if not (value2 or value3) then
          return
        end
        shown.shown = true
        local clones = shown.clones
        if value2 then
          shown.lastTint = arg2
          for index = 1, #clones do
            clones[index].Color = arg2
          end
        end
        if value3 then
          shown.lastTr = total
          for index2 = 1, #clones do
            clones[index2].Transparency = total
          end
        end
      end
      value2.modelPlaceStore = function(arg, arg2, WorldToViewportPoint, arg3)
        for item, item2 in pairs(arg) do
          local root = item2.root
          local value = not (root and root.Parent)
          if ((item2.shown and WorldToViewportPoint) and root) and root.Parent then
            if item2.view ~= nil then
              value = item2.view == false
            else
              local Position = root.Position
              if (Position - arg2).Magnitude > 12 then
                local WorldToViewportPoint2 = WorldToViewportPoint:WorldToViewportPoint(Position)
                local value2, value3 = arg3.X * 0.35, arg3.Y * 0.35
                value = ((((WorldToViewportPoint2.Z < -6) or (WorldToViewportPoint2.X < -value2)) or (WorldToViewportPoint2.X > (arg3.X + value2))) or (WorldToViewportPoint2.Y < -value3)) or (WorldToViewportPoint2.Y > (arg3.Y + value3))
              end
            end
          end
          if item2.shown and value then
            if not item2.parked then
              item2.parked = true
              local cframe, value4 = CFrame.new(0, 30000, 0), {}
              for index = 1, #item2.clones do
                value4[index] = cframe
              end
              pcall(function()
                value:BulkMoveTo(item2.clones, value4, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged)
              end)
            end
          end
          if item2.shown and not value then
            item2.parked = nil
            if (value2.chamsThrough and root) and root.Parent then
              local max = math.max((root.Position - arg2).Magnitude, 0.01)
              local min = math.min(1, value3.modelDepth / max)
              local scale = item2.scale
              if min >= 1 then
                if scale < 1 then
                  value2.modelResize(item2, 1)
                end
              elseif scale >= 1 then
                value2.modelResize(item2, min)
              else
                local value5 = max * scale
                if (value5 < (value3.modelDepth * 0.76)) or (value5 > (value3.modelDepth * 1.3)) then
                  value2.modelResize(item2, min)
                end
              end
            elseif item2.scale ~= 1 then
              value2.modelResize(item2, 1)
            end
            local scale2 = item2.scale
            local cfs, sources = item2.cfs, item2.sources
            if scale2 < 1 then
              local value6 = arg2 * (1 - scale2)
              for index2 = 1, #sources do
                local value7 = sources[index2].CFrame
                cfs[index2] = value7.Rotation + ((value7.Position * scale2) + value6)
              end
            else
              for index3 = 1, #sources do
                cfs[index3] = sources[index3].CFrame
              end
            end
            pcall(value.BulkMoveTo, value, item2.clones, cfs, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged)
          end
        end
      end

        local clock = os.clock()
        local item = arg[arg2]
        local value = ((((item == nil) or (item.char ~= arg3)) or (item.material ~= arg7)) or value2.modelBroken(item)) or ((item.dirty ~= nil) and ((clock - item.dirty) > 0.35))
        if value then
          if not arg4 then
            if item then
              value2.modelDropIn(arg, arg2)
            end
            return
          end
          if (value3.budget or 0) <= 0 then
            if item and (item.char == arg3) then
              item.view = arg9
              value2.modelShow(item, arg4, arg5, arg6)
            end
            return
          end
          value3.budget -= 1
          value2.modelDropIn(arg, arg2)
          local modelRoot = value2.modelRoot()
          if not ((modelRoot and arg7) and arg8) then
            return
          end
          item = value2.modelBuild(arg3, arg7, arg8, modelRoot, value2.poolFor(arg, arg2))
          arg[arg2] = item
          value2.placeBind()
        end
        item.view = arg9
        value2.modelShow(item, arg4, arg5, arg6)
      end

        if (value == 1) and (value2 == 1) then
          return ToHSV
        end

        if (not toneCache or (value3.toneB ~= value)) or (value3.toneS ~= value2) then
          toneCache = {}
          value3.toneCache, value3.toneB, value3.toneS, value3.toneN = toneCache, value, value2, 0
        end
        local ck = value2.ck(ToHSV)
        local item = toneCache[ck]
        if item then
          return item
        end
        local ToHSV2, ToHSV3, ToHSV4 = ToHSV:ToHSV()
        local value3 = ToHSV4 * value
        local fromHSV = Color3.fromHSV(ToHSV2, math.clamp(ToHSV3 * value2, 0, 1), math.clamp(value3, 0, 1))

        if value3.toneN > 4096 then
          value3.toneCache = nil
        end
        toneCache[ck] = fromHSV
        return fromHSV
      end

      value2.upperRaw = function(self)
        local upper = string.upper(self)
        if not string.find(upper, "[\208\209]") then
          return upper
        end
        local value = {}
        for item, item2 in utf8.codes(upper) do
          if (item2 >= 1072) and (item2 <= 1103) then
            item2 -= 32
          elseif item2 == 1105 then
            item2 = 1025
          end
          value[#value + 1] = utf8.char(item2)
        end
        return table.concat(value)
      end

      value2.boundsOf = function(GetChildren, Position)
        local item = value3.bounds[GetChildren]
        local clock = os.clock()
        if not item or ((clock - item.at) > 0.15) then
          local value, value2
          local partKinds = value3.partKinds
          for item2, item3 in ipairs(GetChildren:GetChildren()) do
            local ClassName = item3.ClassName
            local item4 = partKinds[ClassName]
            if item4 == nil then
              item4 = item3:IsA("BasePart")
              partKinds[ClassName] = item4
            end
            if item4 then
              local value3 = item3.Size.Y * 0.5
              local Y = item3.Position.Y
              local total, total2 = Y + value3, Y - value3
              if (value == nil) or (total > value) then
                value = total
              end
              if (value2 == nil) or (total2 < value2) then
                value2 = total2
              end
            end
          end
          local Y2 = Position.Position.Y
          item = {at = clock, top = (value or (Y2 + 3)) - Y2, bottom = (value2 or (Y2 - 3)) - Y2}
          value3.bounds[GetChildren] = item
        end
        return item.top, item.bottom
      end
      value2.project = function(arg, Position)
        local boundsOf, boundsOf2 = value2.boundsOf(arg, Position)
        local Position2 = Position.Position
        local vpt = value2.vpt(Vector3.new(Position2.X, (Position2.Y + boundsOf) + 0.12, Position2.Z))
        local vpt2 = value2.vpt(Vector3.new(Position2.X, (Position2.Y + boundsOf2) - 0.08, Position2.Z))
        if (vpt.Z <= 0.08) or (vpt2.Z <= 0.08) then
          return nil
        end
        local ViewportSize = CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
        local abs = math.abs(vpt2.Y - vpt.Y)
        if (abs < 2) or (abs > (ViewportSize.Y * 4)) then
          return nil
        end
        local value = abs * math.clamp((value2.boxWidth or 50) / 100, 0.2, 1)
        local total = ((vpt.X + vpt2.X) * 0.5) - (value * 0.5)
        local min = math.min(vpt.Y, vpt2.Y)
        if ((((total + value) < 0) or (total > ViewportSize.X)) or ((min + abs) < 0)) or (min > ViewportSize.Y) then
          return nil
        end
        if value < 12 then
          total, value = total - ((12 - value) * 0.5), 12
        end
        if abs < 22 then
          min, abs = min - ((22 - abs) * 0.5), 22
        end
        return {x = total, y = min, w = value, h = abs}
      end
      value2.smoothRect = function(rect, arg, arg2, arg3)
        local value = math.clamp(value2.smooth, 0, 95) / 100
        local value2 = ((value > 0) and (1 - (value ^ (math.clamp(arg2 or 0.016666666666666666, 0.001, 0.1) * 60)))) or 1
        arg3 = arg3 or Vector2.new(arg.x + (arg.w * 0.5), arg.y + (arg.h * 0.5))
        local value3 = {x = arg.x - arg3.X, y = arg.y - arg3.Y, w = arg.w, h = arg.h}
        local value4 = rect.rect and rect.rel
        if value4 then
          local total = ((math.abs(value3.x - value4.x) + math.abs(value3.y - value4.y)) + math.abs(value3.w - value4.w)) + math.abs(value3.h - value4.h)
          if total < (math.max(CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.X, CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.Y) * 0.35) then

      value2.perfOn = function()
        if value2.perfMode == false then
          return false
        end
        if value2.perfMode == true then
          return true
        end
        local touchPerf = value3.touchPerf
        if touchPerf == nil then
          touchPerf = false
          pcall(function()
            local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
            touchPerf = (UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled) or (getgenv().NOVA_FORCE_TOUCH == true)
          end)
          value3.touchPerf = touchPerf
        end
        return touchPerf
      end
      value2.step = function(self)
        if not value2.on then
          if not value3.hidden then
            value2.hideAll()
          end
          if not value3.pruneAt or (os.clock() >= value3.pruneAt) then
            value3.pruneAt = os.clock() + 1
            value2.prune()
          end
          return
        end
        CurrentCamera = value.CurrentCamera or CurrentCamera
        if CurrentCamera == nil then
          value2.hideAll()
          return
        end
        if not value3.poolSweepAt or (os.clock() >= value3.poolSweepAt) then
          value3.poolSweepAt = os.clock() + 5
          pcall(value2.poolSweep)
        end
        value3.hidden = false
        value3.budget = 1
        value3.camCF = CurrentCamera.CFrame
        value3.camPos = value3.camCF.Position
        value3.vp = CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
        value3.pcf, value3.pcx, value3.pcy = value3.camCF, value3.vp.X * 0.5, value3.vp.Y * 0.5
        value3.pf = value3.pcy / math.tan(math.rad(CurrentCamera.FieldOfView) * 0.5)
        value3.pok = false
        do
          local total = ((value3.camPos + (value3.camCF.LookVector * 20)) + (value3.camCF.RightVector * 3)) + (value3.camCF.UpVector * 2)
          local WorldToViewportPoint = CurrentCamera:WorldToViewportPoint(total)
          local PointToObjectSpace = value3.pcf:PointToObjectSpace(total)
          local value = -PointToObjectSpace.Z
          if value > 0.08 then
            local total2, total3 = value3.pcx + ((PointToObjectSpace.X / value) * value3.pf), value3.pcy - ((PointToObjectSpace.Y / value) * value3.pf)
            value3.pok = ((math.abs(total2 - WorldToViewportPoint.X) < 0.5) and (math.abs(total3 - WorldToViewportPoint.Y) < 0.5)) and (math.abs(value - WorldToViewportPoint.Z) < 0.05)
          end
        end
        local value = (item4[1][item4[3]] and item4[1][item4[3]]()) or {}
        local value2 = {}
        value3.frameN = (value3.frameN or 0) + 1
        value3.skipDt = value3.skipDt or setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
        local perfOn = value2.perfOn()
        local number = 0
        for item, item2 in ipairs(PulsePlayers()) do
          if item2 ~= item11 then
            value2[item2] = true
            number += 1
            if (perfOn and (((number + value3.frameN) % 2) == 1)) and (value3.objects[item2] ~= nil) then
              value3.skipDt[item2] = (value3.skipDt[item2] or 0) + self
            elseif not value3.retryAt[item2] or (os.clock() >= value3.retryAt[item2]) then
              local total = self + (value3.skipDt[item2] or 0)
              value3.skipDt[item2] = nil
              local value3, value4 = pcall(value2.updatePlayer, item2, total, value)
              if not value3 then
                value3.lastError = tostring(value4)
                value3.retryAt[item2] = os.clock() + 0.5
                value2.hideSet(value3.objects[item2], true)
                value2.dropCham(item2)
                value2.fxDrop(item2)
                value2.radarHide(item2)
                value2.labelsHide(item2)
              else
                value3.retryAt[item2] = nil
              end
            end
          end
        end
        local extraPlayers = value2.extraPlayers
        if type(extraPlayers) == "table" then
          for item3, item4 in ipairs(extraPlayers) do
            value2[item4] = true
            local value5, value6 = pcall(value2.updatePlayer, item4, self, value)
            if not value5 then
              value3.lastError = tostring(value6)
            end
          end
        end
        value3.pok = false
        for item5 in pairs(value3.objects) do
          if not value2[item5] then
            value2.release(item5)
          end
        end
      end

      end

  e = function(self)
    local item = self[0]
    return function(byte, byte2)
      local value = {}
      for index = 0, 255 do
        value[index] = index
      end
      local number = 0
      for index2 = 0, 255 do
        number = ((number + value[index2]) + byte:byte((index2 % #byte) + 1)) % 256
        value[index2], value[number] = value[number], value[index2]
      end
      local value2, number2, number3 = {}, 0, 0
      for index3 = 1, #byte2 do
        number2 = (number2 + 1) % 256
        number3 = (number3 + value[number2]) % 256
        value[number2], value[number3] = value[number3], value[number2]
        value2[index3] = string.char(item(byte2:byte(index3), value[(value[number2] + value[number3]) % 256]))
      end
      return table.concat(value2)
    end
  end,

        if number == 56 then

          continue
        end
      end
    until false
    return nil

      function value5.paintCard(state)
        local item = state.item
        if not item then
          return
        end
        state.title.Text = tostring(item.t or "")

          state.uid = item.u
          state.av.Image = func8(item.u)
        end
        value5.paintPill(state.pVal, state.pCnt, state.pill, item)
        local value, value2 = tostring(item.n or ""), tostring(item.dn or "")
        state.author.Text = ((value2 ~= "") and value2) or ("@" .. value)
        state.age.Text = func6(item.c)
        state.dls.Text = func7(item.dl)

      function value5.toggleFav(self)
        if value5.favs[self.id] then
          value5.favs[self.id] = nil
        else
          value5.favs[self.id] = true
        end
        value5.saveFavs()
        if (value5.view == "saved") and not value5.favs[self.id] then
          task.defer(value5.render)
        end
      end
      function value5.render()
        local items = value5.items
        for item, item2 in ipairs(items) do
          local item3 = value5.cards[item]
          if not item3 then
            item3 = value5.makeCard()
            value5.cards[item] = item3
          end
          item3.item = item2
          item3.card.LayoutOrder = item
          item3.card.Visible = not ((value5.view == "saved") and not value5.favs[item2.id])
          value5.paintCard(item3)
        end
        for index = #items + 1, #value5.cards do
          value5.cards[index].card.Visible = false
          value5.cards[index].item = nil
        end
        value11.moreB.Visible = value5.more and (value5.view == "all")
        local number = 0
        for index2 = 1, #items do
          if value5.cards[index2].card.Visible then
            number += 1
          end
        end
        value11.search.PlaceholderText = (((value5.all or 0) > 0) and string.format(func("Search configs  \194\183  %d"), value5.all)) or func("Search configs or players")
        value11.mineL.Text = string.format(func("Published %d/%d"), value5.mineCount, value5.maxLive)
        for item4, item5 in ipairs(value11.mineDots) do
          paint(item5, "BackgroundColor3", ((item4 <= value5.mineCount) and "Accent") or "Elevated", "Quick")
        end
        value11.empty.Visible = not value5.loading and (number == 0)
        if value11.empty.Visible then
          local value = ((((value5.err and "No connection") or ((value5.view == "saved") and "No saved configs")) or ((value5.view == "mine") and "No published configs")) or ((value5.q ~= "") and "Nothing found")) or "No configs yet"
          value11.eText.Text = func(value)
          value11.ePub.Visible = not value5.err and (value5.view == "mine")
          pcall(Nova.Icons.apply, value11.eIcon, ((value5.view == "saved") and "star") or (((value5.view == "mine") and "upload") or (((value5.q ~= "") and "search") or "library")))
        end
        if value5.loading and (#items == 0) then
          value11.empty.Visible = true
          value11.ePub.Visible = false
          value11.eText.Text = func("Loading")
          pcall(Nova.Icons.apply, value11.eIcon, "refresh-cw")
        end
      end
      function value5.load(self)
        value5.gen += 1
        local gen = value5.gen
        if self then
          value5.page = 0
          value5.items = {}
        end
        value5.loading = true
        value5.err = nil
        value5.loadedAt = os.clock()
        pcall(value5.render)
        task.spawn(function()
          local items, value
          if value5.view == "mine" then
            items, value = value5.api("mine", {})
          elseif value5.view == "saved" then
            local value2 = {}
            for item in pairs(value5.favs) do
              value2[#value2 + 1] = item
            end
            items, value = value5.api("list", {ids = value2, sort = value5.sort})
          else
            items, value = value5.api("list", {q = value5.q, sort = value5.sort, page = value5.page})
          end
          if gen ~= value5.gen then
            return
          end
          value5.loading = false
          if not items then
            value5.err = value or "net"
            pcall(value5.render)
            if value5.page > 0 then
              func3(func2(value), nil, "danger")
            end
            return
          end
          value5.mod = (items.mod == true) or value5.mod
          local value3 = ((type(items.items) == "table") and items.items) or {}
          if value5.view == "mine" then
            value5.maxLive = tonumber(items.max) or value5.maxLive
            local number = 0
            for item2, item3 in ipairs(value3) do
              if (item3.st == 0) or (item3.st == 3) then
                number += 1
              end
            end
            value5.mineCount = number
          end
          if value5.view == "saved" then
            local value4 = {}
            for item4, item5 in ipairs(value3) do
              value4[item5.id] = true
            end
            local flag = false
            for item6 in pairs(value5.favs) do
              if not value4[item6] then
                value5.favs[item6] = nil
                flag = true
              end
            end
            if flag then
              value5.saveFavs()
            end
          end
          for item7, item8 in ipairs(value3) do
            table.insert(value5.items, item8)
          end
          value5.more = items.more == true
          value5.total = tonumber(items.total) or #value5.items
          if items.all ~= nil then
            value5.all = tonumber(items.all) or value5.all
          end
          pcall(value5.render)
        end)
      end

      function value15.strip(self)
        local value, value2 = pcall(function()
          return HttpService:JSONDecode(HttpService:JSONEncode(self))
        end)
        if (not value or (type(value2) ~= "table")) or (type(value2.s) ~= "table") then
          return nil
        end
        local s = value2.s
        if type(s.vote) == "table" then
          s.vote.last = nil
        end
        if type(s.music) == "table" then
          s.music.custom = nil
        end
        if type(value2.nova) == "table" then
          value2.nova.winPos, value2.nova.touchPos, value2.nova.touchSize = nil, nil, nil
        end
        if type(s.ui) == "table" then
          for item in pairs(item10.PERSONAL_UI or {}) do
            s.ui[item] = nil
          end
        end
        if type(s.ctrl) == "table" then
          for item2 in pairs(s.ctrl) do
            if ((type(item2) ~= "string") or (item2:sub(1, 2) == "__")) or (item10.PERSONAL_CTRL or {})[item2] then
              s.ctrl[item2] = nil
            end
          end
        end
        return {
          v = 1,
          game = "mm2",
          s = s,
          fa = ((type(value2.fa) == "string") and value2.fa) or nil,
          vis = ((type(value2.vis) == "table") and value2.vis) or nil,
          skins = ((type(value2.skins) == "string") and value2.skins) or nil,
          nova = ((type(value2.nova) == "table") and value2.nova) or nil
        }
      end
      function value15.submit()
        if value15.busy then
          return
        end
        local entry = value15.entry
        if not entry then
          func3(func("Create a config in Settings first"), nil, "warning")
          return
        end
        local s = value15.title.Text:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
        if (#s < 3) or (#s > 32) then
          func3(func2("title"), nil, "warning")
          return
        end
        local s2 = value15.desc.Text:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
        local value = {}
        for item, item2 in ipairs(value3) do
          if value15.tags[item2] then
            value[#value + 1] = item2
          end
        end
        local strip = value15.strip(entry.data)
        if not strip then
          func3(func2("data"), nil, "danger")
          return
        end
        value15.busy = true
        value15.goL.Text = func("Loading")
        local publish, publish2 = value5.api("publish", {title = s, desc = s2, tags = value, data = strip})
        value15.busy = false
        value15.goL.Text = func("Publish")
        if not publish then
          func3(func2(publish2), nil, "danger")
          return
        end
        func3(func("Published"), s, "success")
        value15.title.Text, value15.desc.Text, value15.autoTitle = "", "", nil
        value15.tags = {}
        value15.paintTags()
        value5.setView("mine")
      end
