            function value2:_applyBackground()
              local BgLayers = self.BgLayers
              if not BgLayers then
                return
              end
              local BgStyle, BgIntensity = self.BgStyle, self.BgIntensity
              local function func(self)
                return math.clamp(1 - ((1 - self) * BgIntensity), 0, 1)
              end
              local equal = BgStyle == "Aurora"
              if BgLayers.meshA then
                BgLayers.meshA.ImageTransparency = func((equal and 0.84) or 0.965)
              end
              if BgLayers.meshB then
                BgLayers.meshB.ImageTransparency = func((equal and 0.9) or 0.975)
              end
              if BgLayers.auraA then
                BgLayers.auraA.ImageTransparency = func((equal and 0.84) or 0.9)
              end
              if BgLayers.auraB then
                BgLayers.auraB.ImageTransparency = func((equal and 0.9) or 0.94)
              end
              local item = value3[BgStyle]
              if item then
                local get = Tex.get(item.tex)
                if get then
                  BgLayers.pattern.Image = get
                  BgLayers.pattern.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Tile
                  local item2 = Tex.specs[item.tex]
                  BgLayers.pattern.TileSize = UDim2.fromOffset(item2.w, item2.h)
                  BgLayers.pattern.ImageTransparency = func(item.alpha)
                end
              else
                BgLayers.pattern.ImageTransparency = 1
              end
              if BgLayers.grain then
                BgLayers.grain.ImageTransparency = func(((BgStyle == "Noise") and 0.55) or 0.82)
              end
            end
            function value2:SetBackground(self)

                if item2 == self then
                  self.BgStyle = self
                  self.State.set("bgStyle", self)
                  self:_applyBackground()
                  return
                end
              end
            end

            function value2:ResetAppearance()
              for item, item2 in ipairs({
                "accent",
                "radius",
                "font",
                "textScale",
                "scale",
                "autoFit",
                "blur",
                "bgStyle",
                "bgIntensity",
                "opacity",
                "tooltips",
                "launcher",
                "base",
                "cardStyle",
                "density",
                "watermark",
                "keybindList",
                "sidebarWidth",
                "panel"
              }) do
                self.State.data[item2] = nil
              end
              self.State.save()
              self.PanelColor = nil
              local StateDefaults = self.StateDefaults
              if type(StateDefaults) == "table" then
                if StateDefaults.base then
                  self:SetBase(StateDefaults.base)
                end
                if StateDefaults.panel then
                  pcall(function()
                    self:SetPanelColor(Color3.fromHex(StateDefaults.panel))
                  end)
                end
                if StateDefaults.accent then
                  pcall(function()
                    self:SetAccent(Color3.fromHex(StateDefaults.accent))
                  end)
                end
                self:SetCornerRadius(tonumber(StateDefaults.radius) or 1)
                if StateDefaults.font then
                  self:SetFont(StateDefaults.font)
                end
                self:SetTextScale(tonumber(StateDefaults.textScale) or 1)
                self:SetScale(tonumber(StateDefaults.scale) or self.DefaultScale)
                self:SetAutoFit(StateDefaults.autoFit ~= false)
                self:SetBlur(StateDefaults.blur == true)
                if StateDefaults.bgStyle then
                  self:SetBackground(StateDefaults.bgStyle)
                end
                self:SetBackgroundIntensity(tonumber(StateDefaults.bgIntensity) or 1)
                if StateDefaults.cardStyle then
                  self:SetCardStyle(StateDefaults.cardStyle)
                end
                if StateDefaults.density then
                  self:SetDensity(StateDefaults.density)
                end
                self:SetSidebarWidth(tonumber(StateDefaults.sidebarWidth) or self.DefaultSidebarWidth)
                self:SetOpacity(tonumber(StateDefaults.opacity) or 1)
                if (StateDefaults.groupLabels ~= nil) and self.SetGroupLabels then
                  self:SetGroupLabels(StateDefaults.groupLabels)
                end
                if self.SetTooltips then
                  self:SetTooltips(StateDefaults.tooltips ~= false)
                end
                if (StateDefaults.launcher ~= nil) and self.SetLauncher then
                  self:SetLauncher(StateDefaults.launcher)
                end
                self.State.save()
                if self.OnReset then
                  pcall(self.OnReset)
                end
                return
              end
              Theme.setBase("Midnight")
              Theme.set("Accent", Theme.Presets.Crimson)
              self:SetCornerRadius(1)
              self:SetFont("Builder Sans")
              self:SetTextScale(1)
              self:SetScale(self.DefaultScale)
              self:SetAutoFit(true)
              self:SetBlur(false)
              self:SetBackground("Aurora")
              self:SetBackgroundIntensity(1)
              self:SetCardStyle("Glass")
              self:SetDensity("Comfortable")
              self:SetSidebarWidth(self.DefaultSidebarWidth)
              self:SetOpacity(1)
              self.State.data.accent = nil
              self.State.data.radius = nil
              self.State.data.font = nil
              self.State.data.textScale = nil
              self.State.data.scale = nil
              self.State.data.blur = nil
              self.State.data.bgStyle = nil
              self.State.data.bgIntensity = nil
              self.State.data.opacity = nil
              self.State.save()
              if self.OnReset then
                pcall(self.OnReset)
              end
            end

              })
              if rim9 then

              end
              local Size = func2({
                Parent = MouseEnter,
                Icon = "x",

                Pos = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
                Anchor = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
                Color = "Muted",

              })
              local value2 = (tile2 and "ImageColor3") or "BackgroundColor3"
              MouseEnter.MouseEnter:Connect(function()

            function value2:_savePos()

            end

            function value.screenFactor(self)
              if not self then
                local CurrentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera
                self = (CurrentCamera and CurrentCamera.ViewportSize) or Vector2.new(1920, 1000)
              end
              local min = math.min(self.X / 1920, self.Y / 1000)
              if math.abs(min - 1) < 0.04 then
                min = 1
              end
              return U2.clamp(min, 0.5, 1.3)
            end
            function value2:_placeOnScreen(self)
              local CurrentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera
              local value = (CurrentCamera and CurrentCamera.ViewportSize) or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
              self = self or self.Root.Position
              local value2 = (self.AutoScale or 1) * self.UserScale
              local value3 = Vector2.new(self.Root.Size.X.Offset, self.Root.Size.Y.Offset) * value2
              local total = (self.X.Scale * value.X) + self.X.Offset
              local total2 = (self.Y.Scale * value.Y) + self.Y.Offset
              local value4, value5, number = value3.X / 2, value3.Y / 2, 8
              local value6 = (((value3.X + (number * 2)) >= value.X) and (value.X / 2)) or math.clamp(total, value4 + number, (value.X - value4) - number)
              local value7 = (((value3.Y + (number * 2)) >= value.Y) and (value.Y / 2)) or math.clamp(total2, value5 + number, (value.Y - value5) - number)
              if (math.abs(value6 - total) < 0.5) and (math.abs(value7 - total2) < 0.5) then
                return self
              end
              return UDim2.new(self.X.Scale, math.floor((self.X.Offset + (value6 - total)) + 0.5), self.Y.Scale, math.floor((self.Y.Offset + (value7 - total2)) + 0.5))
            end

            function value2:_autoScale()
              local CurrentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera
              local function func(self)
                local value = (CurrentCamera and CurrentCamera.ViewportSize) or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
                local value2 = (self.AutoFit and value.screenFactor(value)) or 1
                self.ScreenFactor = value2
                self.OverlayScale = (self.AutoFit and U2.clamp(value2, 0.6, 1.2)) or 1
                if self.IsTouch then
                  local clamp = U2.clamp((value.Y - 16) / 440, 0.55, 1)
                  local clamp2 = U2.clamp((clamp * self.UserScale) / math.max(self.DefaultScale or 1, 0.1), 0.45, 1.3)
                  local floor = math.floor(math.min(self.BaseSize.X, (value.X - 16) / clamp2))
                  local floor2 = math.floor(math.min(self.BaseSize.Y, (value.Y - 16) / clamp2))
                  local TouchSize = self.TouchSize
                  local value3, value4
                  if TouchSize then
                    value3 = math.floor(U2.clamp(TouchSize.X, math.min(360, floor), floor))
                    value4 = math.floor(U2.clamp(TouchSize.Y, math.min(240, floor2), floor2))
                  else
                    value3 = math.min(floor, math.floor((value.X * 0.72) / clamp2))
                    value4 = math.min(floor2, math.floor((value.Y * 0.86) / clamp2))
                  end
                  if (self.Size.X ~= value3) or (self.Size.Y ~= value4) then
                    self.Size = Vector2.new(value3, value4)
                    self.Root.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(value3, value4)
                  end
                  self.AutoScale = clamp2 / math.max(self.UserScale, 0.1)
                elseif self.AutoFit then
                  local max = math.max(self.UserScale, 0.1)
                  local max2 = math.max(max * value2, math.min(0.6, max))
                  local total, total2 = value.X - 24, value.Y - 24
                  local X, value5 = self.Size.X, self.Size.Y
                  X = math.max(math.min(self.MinSize.X, X), math.min(X, math.floor(total / max2)))
                  value5 = math.max(math.min(self.MinSize.Y, value5), math.min(value5, math.floor(total2 / max2)))
                  local min = math.min(1, total / (X * max2), total2 / (value5 * max2))
                  local fromOffset = UDim2.fromOffset(X, value5)
                  if self.Root.Size ~= fromOffset then
                    self.Root.Size = fromOffset
                  end
                  self.AutoScale = U2.clamp(max2 * min, 0.3, 1.8) / max
                else
                  local min2 = math.min(1, (value.X - 30) / self.Size.X, (value.Y - 30) / self.Size.Y)
                  self.AutoScale = U2.clamp(min2, 0.45, 1)
                end
                self.Scale.Scale = self.AutoScale * self.UserScale
                self.ToastScale.Scale = U2.clamp(math.min(self.OverlayScale, value.X / 900), 0.55, 1.2)
                self:_syncLayers()
                if not self.Scaling and not self.HomePos then
                  local _placeOnScreen = self:_placeOnScreen(self.Root.Position)
                  if _placeOnScreen ~= self.Root.Position then
                    self.Root.Position = _placeOnScreen
                  end
                end
                for index = #self.ScaleHooks, 1, -1 do
                  local value6, value7 = pcall(self.ScaleHooks[index], self.OverlayScale, value)
                  if value6 and (value7 == false) then
                    table.remove(self.ScaleHooks, index)
                  end
                end
              end
              func()
              if CurrentCamera then
                U2.connect(CurrentCamera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"), func, self.Conns)
              end
              self._applyScale = func
            end

            function value2:_acrylicStep()
              local AcrylicPart, AcrylicMesh, CurrentCamera = self.AcrylicPart, self.AcrylicMesh, workspace.CurrentCamera
              if not ((AcrylicPart and AcrylicMesh) and CurrentCamera) then
                return
              end
              if AcrylicPart.Parent ~= CurrentCamera then
                AcrylicPart.Parent = CurrentCamera
              end
              local Root = self.Root
              local AbsolutePosition, AbsoluteSize = Root.AbsolutePosition, Root.AbsoluteSize
              if (not Root.Visible or (AbsoluteSize.X < 8)) or (AbsoluteSize.Y < 8) then
                AcrylicMesh.Scale = Vector3.zero
                return
              end
              local total = math.floor((((14 * (U2.radiusMult or 1)) * math.max(self.Scale.Scale, 0.1)) * 0.3) + 0.5) + 2
              local function func(arg, arg2)
                local ScreenPointToRay = CurrentCamera:ScreenPointToRay(arg, arg2)
                return ScreenPointToRay.Origin + (ScreenPointToRay.Direction * 0.001)
              end
              local value = func(AbsolutePosition.X + total, AbsolutePosition.Y + total)
              local value2 = func((AbsolutePosition.X + AbsoluteSize.X) - total, AbsolutePosition.Y + total)
              local value3 = func((AbsolutePosition.X + AbsoluteSize.X) - total, (AbsolutePosition.Y + AbsoluteSize.Y) - total)
              local value4 = CurrentCamera.CFrame
              AcrylicPart.CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix((value + value3) / 2, value4.XVector, value4.YVector, value4.ZVector)
              AcrylicMesh.Scale = Vector3.new((value2 - value).Magnitude, (value2 - value3).Magnitude, 0)
            end

              local RunService = value.Services.RunService
              self.AcrylicToken = (self.AcrylicToken or 0) + 1

                  end)

                end
                if self.AcrylicDof then
                  pcall(function()

                  end)
                  self.AcrylicDof = nil
                end

              end

            local function func(self)
              self = string.lower(tostring(self or ""))
              self = string.gsub(self, "<[^>]->", "")
              self = string.gsub(self, "\208([\144-\159])", function(self)
                return "\208" .. string.char(string.byte(self) + 32)
              end)
              self = string.gsub(self, "\208([\160-\175])", function(self)
                return "\209" .. string.char(string.byte(self) - 32)
              end)
              self = string.gsub(self, "\208([\129\132\134\135])", function(self)
                return "\209" .. string.char(string.byte(self) + 16)
              end)
              return self
            end

            end

            function WindowClass:_searchRank(self)
              local value = func(self)
              value = string.gsub(value, "^%s+", "")
              value = string.gsub(value, "%s+$", "")
              if value == "" then
                return {}, value
              end
              local value2 = {}
              for item in string.gmatch(value, "%S+") do
                table.insert(value2, item)
              end
              local value3, value4 = {}, {}
              for item2, item3 in ipairs(self:_searchCollect()) do
                local number = 0
                local find = string.find(item3.titleL, value, 1, true)
                if find == 1 then
                  number = 120
                elseif find then
                  number = 70
                end
                local flag, value5 = true, find ~= nil
                for item4, item5 in ipairs(value2) do
                  if string.find(item3.titleL, item5, 1, true) then
                    number += 18
                    value5 = true
                  elseif string.find(item3.hay, item5, 1, true) then
                    number += 4
                  else
                    flag = false
                    break
                  end
                end
                if flag and (value5 or (item3.kind ~= "row")) then
                  local text = item3.kind .. ("|" .. (item3.title .. ("|" .. item3.path)))
                  if not value4[text] then
                    value4[text] = true
                    item3.score = (number + value5[item3.kind]) - (#item3.titleL / 40)
                    table.insert(value3, item3)
                  end
                end
              end
              table.sort(value3, function(score, score2)
                return score.score > score2.score
              end)
              while #value3 > number3 do
                table.remove(value3)
              end
              return value3, value
            end

            function value2:_fitSubs()

                  return

              end
              if (number == 0) or (number2 <= 0) then
                return
              end
              number2 = number2 / value4
              local total = ((number - 1) * 2) + 6
              local number3, number4, number5 = 22, 15, 1
              if (((number2 + (number * 30)) + total) + 44) > value3 then

                    number4, number3 = 3, 4
                    number5 = (((value3 - (number3 * 2)) - total) - (number * 6)) / number2

            WindowClass.CardStyles = {"Glass", "Frosted", "Tinted", "Flat"}
            function WindowClass:_applyCardStyle(Gloss)
              local value = self.CardStyle or "Glass"
              local Card = Gloss.Card
              if not Card then
                return
              end
              local Accent = Theme.resolve("Accent")
              if value == "Flat" then
                Card.BackgroundTransparency = 0
                Gloss.CardGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(color3)
                if Gloss.Gloss then
                  Gloss.Gloss.ImageTransparency = 1
                end
                if Gloss.Grain then
                  Gloss.Grain.ImageTransparency = 1
                end
              elseif value == "Frosted" then
                Card.BackgroundTransparency = 0.32
                Gloss.CardGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(color3, Color3.fromRGB(220, 222, 230))
                if Gloss.Gloss then
                  Gloss.Gloss.ImageTransparency = 0.72
                end
                if Gloss.Grain then
                  Gloss.Grain.ImageTransparency = 0.9
                end
              elseif value == "Tinted" then
                Card.BackgroundTransparency = 0.03
                Gloss.CardGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(color3:Lerp(Accent, 0.05), color3:Lerp(Accent, 0.34))
                if Gloss.Gloss then
                  Gloss.Gloss.ImageTransparency = 0.88
                end
                if Gloss.Grain then
                  Gloss.Grain.ImageTransparency = 0.94
                end
              else
                Card.BackgroundTransparency = 0.03
                Gloss.CardGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(color3, Color3.fromRGB(208, 210, 218))
                if Gloss.Gloss then
                  Gloss.Gloss.ImageTransparency = 0.9
                end
                if Gloss.Grain then
                  Gloss.Grain.ImageTransparency = 0.94
                end
              end
            end
            function WindowClass:SetCardStyle(self)
              value.trace("SetCardStyle")
              for item, item2 in ipairs(WindowClass.CardStyles) do
                if item2 == self then
                  self.CardStyle = self
                  self.State.set("cardStyle", self)
                  for item3, item4 in ipairs(self.TabList) do
                    for item5, item6 in ipairs(item4.Sections) do
                      self:_applyCardStyle(item6)
                    end
                  end
                  return
                end
              end
            end
            function WindowClass:_nextZ()
              self.FloatZ += 1
              return self.FloatZ
            end
            function WindowClass:_initCards()
              U2.connect(UserInputService.InputChanged, function(self)
                if self.CardPress and U2.sameMove(self, self.CardPress.input) then
                  self:_cardMove()
                end
              end, self.Conns)
              U2.connect(UserInputService.InputEnded, function(self)
                if U2.sameEnd(self, self.CardPress and self.CardPress.input) then
                  self:_cardEnd()
                end
              end, self.Conns)
            end
            function WindowClass:_cardPress(Floating, arg)
              self.CardPress = {sec = Floating, at = U2.at(arg), t = os.clock(), input = arg}
              if Floating.Floating then
                Floating.Wrap.ZIndex = self:_nextZ()
              end
            end
            function WindowClass:_cardMove()
              local CardPress = self.CardPress
              if not CardPress then
                return
              end
              local sec = CardPress.sec
              local at = U2.at(CardPress.input)
              local max = math.max(self.FloatScale.Scale, 0.1)
              if not self.CardDrag then
                local Magnitude = (at - CardPress.at).Magnitude
                if sec.Floating then
                  if Magnitude < 4 then
                    return
                  end
                else
                  if self.IsTouch and ((os.clock() - CardPress.t) < 0.35) then
                    if Magnitude >= 10 then
                      self.CardPress = nil
                    end
                    return
                  end
                  if (Magnitude < 12) or ((os.clock() - CardPress.t) < 0.08) then
                    return
                  end
                  local value = (sec.Card.AbsolutePosition - self.FloatLayer.AbsolutePosition) / max
                  self:FloatSection(sec, value)
                  Sound.play("click", 0.8)
                end
                local value2 = (sec.Wrap.AbsolutePosition - self.FloatLayer.AbsolutePosition) / max
                self.CardDrag = {sec = sec, grab = ((at - self.FloatLayer.AbsolutePosition) / max) - value2, fresh = not sec.WasFloating}
                self:HideTip()
                tween(sec.Shadow, "Quick", {ImageTransparency = 0.25})
              end
              local CardDrag = self.CardDrag
              local total = ((at - self.FloatLayer.AbsolutePosition) / max) - CardDrag.grab
              local value3 = self.FloatLayer.AbsoluteSize / max
              local value4 = sec.Wrap.AbsoluteSize / max
              total = Vector2.new(math.clamp(total.X, (8 - value4.X) + 80, value3.X - 80), math.clamp(total.Y, 4, value3.Y - 40))
              sec.Wrap.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(total.X, total.Y)
              if sec.Slot and sec.SlotStroke then
                local total2 = sec.Slot.AbsolutePosition + (sec.Slot.AbsoluteSize / 2)
                local total3 = sec.Wrap.AbsolutePosition + Vector2.new(sec.Wrap.AbsoluteSize.X / 2, math.min(sec.Wrap.AbsoluteSize.Y / 2, 40))
                local value5 = (self.IsOpen and (sec.Tab == self.Current)) and ((total2 - total3).Magnitude < (110 * max))
                if value5 ~= sec.NearSlot then
                  sec.NearSlot = value5
                  tween(sec.SlotStroke, "Quick", {Transparency = (value5 and 0.2) or 0.86})
                  if sec.SlotGlow then
                    tween(sec.SlotGlow, "Quick", {ImageTransparency = (value5 and 0.7) or 1})
                  end
                end
              end
            end
            function WindowClass:_cardEnd()
              local CardPress = self.CardPress
              self.CardPress = nil
              local CardDrag = self.CardDrag
              if not CardDrag then
                return
              end
              self.CardDrag = nil
              self.LastCardDrag = os.clock()
              local sec = CardDrag.sec
              tween(sec.Shadow, "Base", {ImageTransparency = 0.3})
              if sec.NearSlot then
                sec.NearSlot = false
                self:DockSection(sec)
                return
              end
              local Position = sec.Wrap.Position
              local floats = self.State.get("floats", {})
              if type(floats) ~= "table" then
                floats = {}

            function WindowClass:RegisterKeybind(self)

            function WindowClass:_kbDirty()
              if self.KbPending or self.Destroyed then
                return
              end
              self.KbPending = true
              task.defer(function()
                self.KbPending = false
                if self.KeybindFrame and not self.Destroyed then
                  self:_kbRebuild()
                end
              end)
            end

            function WindowClass:_kbCapture(capture)
              if self.KbCap == capture then
                return
              end
              self:_kbCancel()
              self.KbCap = capture
              capture.capture(true)
              task.defer(function()
                if self.KbCap == capture then
                  self.Listening = true
                end
              end)
            end
            function WindowClass:_kbCancel()
              local KbCap = self.KbCap
              if not KbCap then
                return
              end
              self.KbCap = nil
              KbCap.capture(false)
              task.defer(function()
                if not self.KbCap then
                  self.Listening = false
                end
              end)
            end

        local function func2(sub)
          for item, item2 in ipairs({crypt and crypt.base64decode, base64decode, base64_decode, base64 and base64.decode}) do
            if type(item2) == "function" then
              local value, value2 = pcall(item2, sub)

              end

          local value3 = {}
          for index = 1, 64 do
            value3[ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789:sub(index, index)] = index - 1
          end
          local value4 = {}
          sub = sub:gsub("[^%w%+/=]", "")

            local value5 = value3[sub:sub(number, number)] or 0
            local value6 = value3[sub:sub(number + 1, number + 1)] or 0
            local item3, item4 = value3[sub:sub(number + 2, number + 2)], value3[sub:sub(number + 3, number + 3)]
            value4[#value4 + 1] = string.char((value5 * 4) + math.floor(value6 / 16))
            if item3 then
              value4[#value4 + 1] = string.char(((value6 % 16) * 16) + math.floor(item3 / 4))
              if item4 then
                value4[#value4 + 1] = string.char(((item3 % 4) * 64) + item4)
              end
            end
            number += 4
          end
          return table.concat(value4)
        end

        value.DATA = nil
        value.data = function()
          if value.DATA then
            return value.DATA
          end
          local isyieldable = coroutine.isyieldable()
          if value.loading then
            if not isyieldable then
              value.missed = true
              return nil
            end
            local clock = os.clock()
            while value.loading and ((os.clock() - clock) < 30) do
              task.wait(0.05)
            end
            return value.DATA
          end
          if not isyieldable then
            value.missed = true
            task.spawn(value.data)
            return nil
          end
          value.loading = true
          pcall(function()
            local aura_data = getgenv().__pulseData.take("aura_data")
            if not aura_data then
              return
            end
            local value = loadstring("return {" .. (aura_data .. "}"))
            if not value then
              return
            end
            setfenv(value, {})
            local value2 = value()
            if type(value2) == "table" then
              value.DATA = value2
            end
          end)
          value.loading = false
          if (value.DATA and value.missed) and value.onData then
            value.missed = false
            pcall(value.onData)
          end
          return value.DATA
        end

        value.dec = function(self)
          if type(self) ~= "table" then
            return self
          end
          local item = self[1]
          if item == 1 then
            return Color3.new(self[2], self[3], self[4])
          end
          if item == 2 then
            return Vector3.new(self[2], self[3], self[4])
          end
          if item == 3 then
            return Vector2.new(self[2], self[3])
          end
          if item == 4 then
            return NumberRange.new(self[2], self[3])
          end
          if item == 5 then
            local value = {}
            for index = 2, #self, 3 do
              value[#value + 1] = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(self[index], self[index + 1], self[index + 2])
            end
            return NumberSequence.new(value)
          end
          if item == 6 then
            local value2 = {}
            for index2 = 2, #self, 4 do
              value2[#value2 + 1] = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(self[index2], Color3.new(self[index2 + 1], self[index2 + 2], self[index2 + 3]))
            end
            return ColorSequence.new(value2)
          end
          if item == 7 then
            return CFrame.new(self[2], self[3], self[4], self[5], self[6], self[7], self[8], self[9], self[10], self[11], self[12], self[13])
          end
          if item == 8 then
            local value3 = tostring(self[2]):gsub("^Enum%.", "")
            local value4, value5 = pcall(function()
              return Enum[value3][self[3]]
            end)
            return (value4 and value5) or nil
          end
          return nil
        end

        value.build = function(arg, arg2, size)
          if arg.g and size.off[arg.g] then
            return
          end
          local item = value.CLS[arg.c]
          if not item then
            return
          end
          local instance = Instance.new(item)
          instance.Name = arg.n or item
          if arg.p then
            for item2, item3 in pairs(arg.p) do
              pcall(function()
                instance[item2] = value.dec(item3)
              end)
            end
          end
          if (arg.c == "A") and size.hatHost then
            instance.Position = instance.Position * ((size.hatK or 1) * size.size)
          elseif arg.c == "A" then
            local Position = instance.Position
            local fit = size.fit
            if size.mapA then
              instance.Position = size.mapA(Position)
            else
              if fit then
                Position = Vector3.new(Position.X * fit.x, fit.f + ((Position.Y + 3) * fit.y), Position.Z * fit.z)
              end
              instance.Position = (Position * size.size) + size.liftV
            end
          elseif arg.c == "PT" then
            instance.Anchored, instance.CanCollide, instance.CanQuery, instance.CanTouch, instance.Massless, instance.CastShadow = false, false, false, false, true, false
            local value = (size.hatK or 1) * size.size
            instance.Size = instance.Size * value
            local value2 = value.dec(arg.r) or CFrame.new()
            value2 = CFrame.new((value2.Position - Vector3.new(0, size.hatCrown or 0, 0)) * value) * value2.Rotation
            local hatHost = size.hatHost
            if hatHost then
              instance.CFrame = hatHost.CFrame * value2
              local instance2 = Instance.new("Weld")
              instance2.Part0, instance2.Part1, instance2.C0 = hatHost, instance, value2
              instance2.Parent = instance
            end
            local value3 = size.opt.alpha or 1
            if value3 ~= 1 then
              instance.Transparency = 1 - ((1 - instance.Transparency) * value3)
            end
          elseif arg.c == "SH" then
            local value4 = (size.hatK or 1) * size.size
            instance.Scale = instance.Scale * value4
            instance.Offset = instance.Offset * value4
          elseif arg.c == "HL" then
            local value5, value6 = size.opt.alpha or 1, size.opt.bright or 1
            instance.FillTransparency = 1 - math.clamp(((1 - instance.FillTransparency) * value5) * value6, 0, 1)
            instance.OutlineTransparency = 1 - math.clamp((1 - instance.OutlineTransparency) * value5, 0, 1)
          elseif (arg.c == "FI") and size.hatHost then
            instance.Size = math.clamp((instance.Size * (size.hatK or 1)) * size.size, 2, 30)
          elseif arg.c == "P" then
            instance.LockedToPart = true
          elseif arg.c == "T" then
            instance.Lifetime = math.min(instance.Lifetime, 0.3)
          end
          if arg.i then
            size.ids[arg.i] = instance
          end
          if arg.a or arg.b then
            size.links[#size.links + 1] = {instance, arg.a, arg.b}
          end
          if arg.g then
            value.tune(instance, size.opt)
          elseif size.hatTune and value.HATFX[arg.c] then
            value.tune(instance, size.hatTune)
          end
          value.mark(instance, size.key)
          if arg.k then
            for item4, item5 in ipairs(arg.k) do
              value.build(item5, instance, size)
            end
          end
          instance.Parent = arg2
          return instance
        end

                value[item4[2]] = (value[item4[1]] * item4[3]) * item4[4]:Inverse()

        value.hatPulse = function(col, arg)
          for item, item2 in ipairs(col.col) do

            if (item4 == 1) and (item2.tr < 1) then
              item3.Transparency = item2.tr + (((1 - item2.tr) * 0.6) * arg)

        value.hatStep = function()
          local clock = os.clock()
          local value, value2 = {}, {}
          for item, item2 in ipairs(value.hats) do
            if item2.root.Parent and item2.w.Parent then
              value[#value + 1] = item2
              local value3 = (clock - item2.t0) * item2.spd
              local motion, k = item2.motion, item2.k
              local base = item2.base
              if motion == "Spin" then
                base = base * CFrame.Angles(0, value3 * 1.5, 0)
              elseif motion == "Float" then
                base = base * CFrame.new(0, ((math.sin(value3 * 2.2) + 1) * 0.08) * k, 0)
              elseif motion == "Spin + Float" then
                base = (base * CFrame.new(0, ((math.sin(value3 * 2.2) + 1) * 0.08) * k, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, value3 * 1.5, 0)
              elseif motion == "Sway" then
                base = base * CFrame.Angles(math.sin(value3 * 1.7) * 0.1, 0, math.sin((value3 * 1.3) + 1.1) * 0.1)
              elseif motion == "Wobble" then
                local value4 = value3 * 2.6
                base = base * CFrame.fromAxisAngle(Vector3.new(math.cos(value4), 0, math.sin(value4)), 0.13)
              elseif motion == "Hover" then
                base = (base * CFrame.new(0, (0.45 + (math.sin(value3 * 1.8) * 0.1)) * k, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, value3 * 0.9, 0)
              elseif motion == "Bounce" then
                base = base * CFrame.new(0, (math.abs(math.sin(value3 * 3.2)) * 0.2) * k, 0)
              end
              if motion ~= "None" then
                item2.w.C0 = base
                item2.still = false
              elseif not item2.still then
                item2.w.C0 = base
                item2.still = true
              end
              local fx = item2.fx
              if (fx ~= "None") and ((clock - (item2.fxAt or 0)) >= 0.025) then
                item2.fxAt = clock
                if (fx == "Rainbow") or (fx == "Wave") then
                  value.hatPaint(item2, (value3 * 0.22) % 1, fx == "Wave")
                elseif fx == "Pulse" then
                  value.hatPulse(item2, 0.5 - (0.5 * math.cos(value3 * 3.2)))
                end
              end
              if item2.hide then
                if (clock - (item2.hideAt or 0)) > 0.5 then
                  item2.hideAt = clock
                  item2.hideList = value.hideList(item2.ch, item2.hide)
                end
                for item3, item4 in ipairs(item2.hideList or {}) do
                  value2[item4] = true
                  if item4.LocalTransparencyModifier < 1 then
                    item4.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
                  end
                end
              end
            end
          end
          value.hats = value
          for item5 in pairs(value.hidden) do
            if not value2[item5] then
              pcall(function()
                item5.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
              end)
            end
          end
          value.hidden = value2
        end
        value.hatLoop = function()
          if value.hatOn then
            return

          value.hatOn = true
          item12(game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped, function()
            if (#value.hats == 0) and (next(value.hidden) == nil) then
              return
            end
            local value, value2 = pcall(value.hatStep)
            if not value and not value.hatErr then
              value.hatErr = true
              warn("[Pulse] hat: " .. tostring(value2))
            end
          end)
        end

              if arg2 == "fx" then

                item2.fx = arg3
                if arg3 == "None" then

                    getgenv().__pulseVFXTint()

                end
              elseif arg2 == "motion" then
                item2.motion = arg3
                item2.still = false
              elseif arg2 == "spd" then
                local clock = os.clock()
                local value2 = (clock - item2.t0) * item2.spd
                item2.spd = math.clamp(arg3, 0.1, 3)
                item2.t0 = clock - (value2 / item2.spd)
              elseif arg2 == "hide" then
                item2.hide = arg3
                item2.hideAt = 0
              end
            end
          end
        end
        value.putHat = function(FindFirstChild, crown, arg, mine)
          local Head = FindFirstChild:FindFirstChild("Head")
          if not (Head and Head:IsA("BasePart")) then
            return
          end
          local value = mine.size or 1
          local value2 = math.clamp(value.headW(Head) / 1.196, 0.5, 2.5) * (value.HATFIT[arg] or 1)
          local value3 = value2 * value
          local crownOf = value.crownOf(Head)

          end
          item = item or {}
          value4.saved[arg] = item
          item[arg2] = {value = value2}
          return item[arg2]
        end
        value4.baseline = function(arg, arg2)
          local remember = value4.remember(arg, arg2)
          if remember == nil then
            return nil
          end
          local value, value2 = pcall(function()
            return arg[arg2]
          end)
          if (value and remember.hasWritten) and (value2 ~= remember.written) then
            remember.value = value2
          end
          return remember.value
        end
        value4.releaseProp = function(arg, arg2)
          local item = value4.saved[arg]
          local value = item and item[arg2]
          if value == nil then
            return
          end
          pcall(function()
            local item = arg[arg2]
            if value.hasWritten and (item ~= value.written) then
              value.value = item
            end
            arg[arg2] = value.value
          end)
          item[arg2] = nil
          if next(item) == nil then
            value4.saved[arg] = nil
          end
        end
        value4.sync = function(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4)
          if arg == nil then
            return
          end
          if not arg3 then
            value4.releaseProp(arg, arg2)
            return
          end
          local remember = value4.remember(arg, arg2)
          if remember == nil then
            return
          end
          pcall(function()
            local item = arg[arg2]
            if remember.hasWritten and (item ~= remember.written) then
              remember.value = item
            end
            remember.written, remember.hasWritten = arg4, true
            if item ~= arg4 then
              arg[arg2] = arg4
            end
            remember.written = arg[arg2]
          end)
        end
        value4.drop = function(self)
          local item = value4.effects[self]
          value4.effects[self] = nil
          if item ~= nil then
            value4.owned[item] = nil
            pcall(function()
              item:Destroy()
            end)
          end
        end
        value4.ensure = function(arg, arg2, arg3)
          local item = value4.effects[arg]
          if (item ~= nil) and (item.Parent == arg3) then
            return item
          end
          value4.drop(arg)
          local value, value2 = pcall(function()
            local instance = Instance.new(arg2)
            value4.owned[instance] = true
            value4.effects[arg] = instance
            instance.Name = "PulseVisual_" .. arg
            instance.Parent = arg3
            return instance
          end)
          if not value then
            value4.drop(arg)
            return nil
          end
          return value2
        end
        value4.configure = function(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4)
          if not arg3 then
            value4.drop(arg)
            return
          end
          local ensure = value4.ensure(arg, arg2, workspace.CurrentCamera or Lighting)
          if ensure == nil then
            return
          end
          for item, item2 in pairs(arg4) do
            pcall(function()
              ensure[item] = item2
            end)
          end
          ensure.Enabled = true
        end
        value4.ours = function(Name)
          local Name2 = Name.Name
          return (Name2:sub(1, 5) == "Pulse") or (Name2:sub(1, 4) == "Nova")
        end
        value4.targets = function(GetChildren, arg)
          local value, value2 = {}, {}
          if GetChildren == nil then
            return value
          end
          for item, item2 in ipairs(GetChildren:GetChildren()) do
            if (item2:IsA(arg) and not value4.owned[item2]) and not value4.ours(item2) then
              value[#value + 1], value2[item2] = item2, true
            end
          end

            if ((not value2[item3] and item4.Parent) and (item4.Parent.value == GetChildren)) and item3:IsA(arg) then
              value[#value + 1] = item3
            end
          end
          return value
        end
        value4.prune = function()
          for item, item2 in pairs(value4.saved) do
            if (item.Parent == nil) and (item2.Parent == nil) then
              for item3 in pairs(item2) do
                value4.releaseProp(item, item3)
              end
              value4.saved[item] = nil
            end
          end
        end

        value4.apply = function()

        value4.mapRoots = function()

        value4.castShadows = function()
          if not value4.lampShadows then
            return
          end
          local mapRoots = value4.mapRoots()
          local value = (value4.lightRoots ~= nil) and (#value4.lightRoots == #mapRoots)
          if value then
            for item, item2 in ipairs(mapRoots) do
              if value4.lightRoots[item] ~= item2 then
                value = false
                break
              end
            end
          end
          local clock = os.clock()
          if not value or (clock > (value4.lightScanAt or 0)) then
            value4.lightScanAt = (value and math.huge) or (clock + 5)
            value4.lightRoots, value4.lights = mapRoots, {}
            for item3, item4 in ipairs(mapRoots) do
              for item5, item6 in ipairs(item4:GetDescendants()) do
                local ClassName = item6.ClassName
                if ((ClassName == "PointLight") or (ClassName == "SpotLight")) or (ClassName == "SurfaceLight") then
                  value4.lights[#value4.lights + 1] = item6
                end
              end
            end
          end
          for item7, item8 in ipairs(value4.lights or {}) do
            if item8.Parent and not item8.Shadows then
              value4.sync(item8, "Shadows", true, true)
            end
          end
        end
        value4.request = function()
          if (value4.batch or value4.uiSyncing) or value4.queued then
            return
          end
          value4.queued = true
          local epoch = value4.epoch
          task.defer(function()
            if epoch ~= value4.epoch then
              return
            end
            value4.queued = false
            if item[1][item[3]]() and value4.on then
              value4.apply()
            end
          end)
        end
        value4.disconnect = function(self)
          for item, item2 in ipairs(self) do

        end

          end
          value4.watchedCamera = CurrentCamera

        end

            return

          value4.watching = true
          value4.conns[#value4.conns + 1] = item12(workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"), value4.watchCamera, true)
          value4.conns[#value4.conns + 1] = item12(Lighting.ChildAdded, function(self)
            if not value4.applying and not value4.owned[self] then
              value4.request()

          value4.conns[#value4.conns + 1] = item12(Lighting.Changed, function(self)
            if value4.applying or not value4.on then
              return
            end
            local item = value4.saved[Lighting]
            if item and item[self] then
              local value, value2 = pcall(function()
                return Lighting[self]
              end)
              local item2 = item[self]
              if value and (not item2.hasWritten or (value2 ~= item2.written)) then
                item2.value = value2
                value4.request()
              end
            end
          end, true)
          value4.watchCamera()
        end
        value4.unwatch = function()
          value4.epoch = value4.epoch + 1
          value4.queued = false

            value4.screen = nil

        item6.visApply = function(self)

              end
            end
          end

        value4.matSet, value4.matMade, value4.matPrev = "Game", {}, {}
        value4.setMaterials = function(self)
          if self == value4.matSet then
            return
          end
          for item, item2 in pairs(value4.matPrev) do
            pcall(function()
              MaterialService:SetBaseMaterialOverride(Enum.Material[item], item2)
            end)
          end
          value4.matPrev = {}
          for item3, item4 in ipairs(value4.matMade) do
            pcall(function()
              item4:Destroy()
            end)
          end
          value4.matMade = {}
          local item5 = value2[self]
          if item5 then
            for item6, item7 in pairs(item5) do
              pcall(function()
                local instance = Instance.new("MaterialVariant")
                instance.Name = "PulseHD_" .. item6
                instance.BaseMaterial = Enum.Material[item6]
                if item7[1] ~= "" then
                  instance.ColorMap = "rbxassetid://" .. item7[1]
                end
                if item7[2] ~= "" then
                  instance.NormalMap = "rbxassetid://" .. item7[2]
                end
                if item7[3] ~= "" then
                  instance.RoughnessMap = "rbxassetid://" .. item7[3]
                end
                if item7[4] ~= "" then
                  instance.MetalnessMap = "rbxassetid://" .. item7[4]
                end
                instance.StudsPerTile = item7[5]
                instance.Parent = MaterialService
                value4.matMade[#value4.matMade + 1] = instance
                value4.matPrev[item6] = MaterialService:GetBaseMaterialOverride(Enum.Material[item6])
                MaterialService:SetBaseMaterialOverride(Enum.Material[item6], instance.Name)
              end)
            end
          end
          value4.matSet = (item5 and self) or "Game"
        end
        value4.neonLights = {}
        value4.lampScan = function()
          local mapRoots = value4.mapRoots()
          local value = (value4.lampRoots ~= nil) and (#value4.lampRoots == #mapRoots)
          if value then
            for item, item2 in ipairs(mapRoots) do
              if value4.lampRoots[item] ~= item2 then
                value = false
                break
              end
            end
          end
          local clock = os.clock()
          if value and (clock < (value4.lampScanAt or 0)) then
            return
          end
          value4.lampScanAt = clock + ((value and 30) or 5)
          value4.lampRoots, value4.lamps, value4.neons = mapRoots, {}, {}
          for item3, item4 in ipairs(mapRoots) do
            for item5, item6 in ipairs(item4:GetDescendants()) do
              local ClassName = item6.ClassName
              if ((ClassName == "PointLight") or (ClassName == "SpotLight")) or (ClassName == "SurfaceLight") then
                if not value4.owned[item6] and (item6.Name ~= "PulseNeonGlow") then
                  value4.lamps[#value4.lamps + 1] = item6
                end
              elseif (item6:IsA("BasePart") and (item6.Material == Enum.Material.Neon)) and (item6.Transparency < 0.6) then
                value4.neons[#value4.neons + 1] = item6
              end
            end
          end
        end
        value4.lampApply = function()
          local value = tonumber(value4.lampBoost) or 1
          local value2 = value4.on and (math.abs(value - 1) > 0.01)
          if value2 or (value4.on and value4.neonGlow) then
            pcall(value4.lampScan)
          end
          for item, item2 in ipairs(value4.lamps or {}) do
            if item2.Parent then
              local value3 = value2 and value4.baseline(item2, "Brightness")
              value4.sync(item2, "Brightness", value2, (tonumber(value3) or 1) * value)
              local value4 = value2 and value4.baseline(item2, "Range")
              value4.sync(item2, "Range", value2, math.min(60, (tonumber(value4) or 8) * (1 + ((value - 1) * 0.5))))
            end
          end
          for item3, item4 in pairs(value4.neonLights) do
            if not item3.Parent or not item4.Parent then
              pcall(function()
                item4:Destroy()
              end)
              value4.neonLights[item3] = nil
            end
          end
          if value4.on and value4.neonGlow then
            local number = 0
            for item5 in pairs(value4.neonLights) do
              number += 1
            end
            for item6, item7 in ipairs(value4.neons or {}) do
              if number >= 90 then
                break
              end
              if item7.Parent and not value4.neonLights[item7] then
                local Size = item7.Size
                local max = math.max(Size.X, Size.Y, Size.Z)
                if max >= 0.8 then
                  pcall(function()
                    local instance = Instance.new("PointLight")
                    instance.Name = "PulseNeonGlow"
                    instance.Color = item7.Color
                    instance.Brightness = 1.4
                    instance.Range = math.clamp(max * 1.6, 6, 18)
                    instance.Shadows = false
                    instance.Parent = item7
                    value4.owned[instance] = true
                    value4.neonLights[item7] = instance
                    number += 1
                  end)
                end
              end
            end
          else
            for item8, item9 in pairs(value4.neonLights) do
              pcall(function()
                item9:Destroy()
              end)
              value4.neonLights[item8] = nil
            end
          end
        end

        for item3, item4 in ipairs(value4.packs) do
          value4.looks[#value4.looks + 1] = {name = item4.name, shader = true, values = item4.values, pack = true}
          value4.extras[item4.name] = item4.extra
          value4.swatch[item4.name] = item4.sw
        end
        value4.PACK_ATLAS = ""
        value4.loadPackPhotos = function()
          if value4.packAsset == nil then
            value4.packAsset = false
            pcall(function()
              if (type(writefile) ~= "function") or (type(getcustomasset) ~= "function") then
                return
              end
              if ((type(isfolder) == "function") and (type(makefolder) == "function")) and not isfolder("PulseHub") then
                makefolder("PulseHub")
              end
              if not ((type(isfile) == "function") and isfile("PulseHub/shader_packs_v3.jpg")) then
                writefile("PulseHub/shader_packs_v3.jpg", item3(value4.PACK_ATLAS))
              end
              local PulseHubShader_packs_v3Jpg = getcustomasset("PulseHub/shader_packs_v3.jpg")
              if (type(PulseHubShader_packs_v3Jpg) == "string") and (#PulseHubShader_packs_v3Jpg > 0) then
                value4.packAsset = PulseHubShader_packs_v3Jpg
              end
            end)
          end
          if not value4.packAsset then
            return
          end
          for item, item2 in ipairs(value4.packTiles or {}) do
            item2.img.Image = value4.packAsset
            item2.img.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new(((item - 1) % 4) * 256, math.floor((item - 1) / 4) * 128)
            item2.img.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(256, 128)
            item2.img.Visible = true
          end
        end
        value4.applyExtras = function(self)
          local __pulseWeather = rawget(getgenv(), "__pulseWeather")
          if (type(__pulseWeather) ~= "table") or (type(__pulseWeather.settingsChanged) ~= "function") then
            return
          end
          local item = value4.extras[self]
          if not item then
            if value4.extrasOn then
              value4.extrasOn = false
              __pulseWeather.scene = ""
              __pulseWeather.on = false
              pcall(__pulseWeather.settingsChanged)
              if value4.extrasSky and __pulseWeather.setSky then
                pcall(__pulseWeather.setSky, nil)
              end
              value4.extrasSky = nil
              if __pulseWeather.syncUI then
                pcall(__pulseWeather.syncUI)
              end
              if __pulseWeather.paintScenes then
                pcall(__pulseWeather.paintScenes)
              end
            end
            return
          end
          pcall(__pulseWeather.stop)
          local value = {
            quality = true,
            shelter = true,
            sound = true,
            soundVolume = true,
            wet = true,
            wetness = true,
            grade = true,
            matchLight = true,
            radius = true,
            scale = true,
            ripples = true,
            gusts = true
          }
          for item2, item3 in pairs(__pulseWeather.defaults or {}) do
            if not value[item2] and not string.find(item2, "olour", 1, true) then
              __pulseWeather[item2] = item3
            end
          end
          __pulseWeather.scene = ""
          if item.weather then
            __pulseWeather.on = true
            for item4, item5 in pairs(item.weather) do
              __pulseWeather[item4] = item5
            end
          else
            __pulseWeather.on = false
          end
          pcall(__pulseWeather.settingsChanged)
          if item.sky and __pulseWeather.setSky then
            pcall(__pulseWeather.setSky, item.sky)
            value4.extrasSky = item.sky
          end
          value4.extrasOn = true
          if __pulseWeather.syncUI then
            pcall(__pulseWeather.syncUI)
          end
          if __pulseWeather.paintScenes then
            pcall(__pulseWeather.paintScenes)
          end
        end
        value4.nextPreset = function()
          local presetNames = value4.presetNames()
          local number = 1
          for item, item2 in ipairs(presetNames) do

        value.decode = function(self)
          for item, item2 in ipairs({crypt and crypt.base64decode, base64decode, base64_decode, base64 and base64.decode}) do
            if type(item2) == "function" then
              local value, value2 = pcall(item2, self)
              if (value and (type(value2) == "string")) and (#value2 > 0) then
                return value2
              end
            end
          end
          local value3 = {}
          for index = 1, 64 do
            value3[string.byte("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/", index)] = index - 1
          end
          local value4, number = {}, 0
          for index2 = 1, #self - 3, 4 do
            local byte, byte2, byte3, byte4 = string.byte(self, index2, index2 + 3)
            local total = ((((value3[byte] or 0) * 262144) + ((value3[byte2] or 0) * 4096)) + ((value3[byte3] or 0) * 64)) + (value3[byte4] or 0)
            local value5, value6, value7 = math.floor(total / 65536) % 256, math.floor(total / 256) % 256, total % 256
            number += 1
            if byte3 == 61 then
              value4[number] = string.char(value5)
            elseif byte4 == 61 then
              value4[number] = string.char(value5, value6)
            else
              value4[number] = string.char(value5, value6, value7)
            end
          end
          return table.concat(value4)
        end
        value.asset = function(arg, arg2)
          local text = arg .. ("/" .. arg2)
          if value.assets[text] then
            return value.assets[text]
          end
          local item = value.PACKS[arg]
          local value = value.TEX[arg] and value.TEX[arg][arg2]
          if (not (item and value) or (type(writefile) ~= "function")) or (type(getcustomasset) ~= "function") then
            return nil
          end
          local text2 = "PulseHub/texpack/" .. (string.lower(arg) .. ("_" .. (arg2 .. ("_v1." .. item.ext))))
          pcall(function()
            if type(isfolder) == "function" then
              if not isfolder("PulseHub") then
                makefolder("PulseHub")
              end
              if not isfolder("PulseHub/texpack") then
                makefolder("PulseHub/texpack")
              end
            end
            if not ((type(isfile) == "function") and isfile(text2)) then
              local __pulseData = getgenv().__pulseData
              if (arg2 ~= item.icon) and (type(isfile) == "function") then
                value.pre = value.pre or {}
                if not value.pre[arg] then
                  value.pre[arg] = true
                  local value = {}
                  for item in pairs(value.TEX[arg]) do
                    if ((item ~= arg2) and (item ~= item.icon)) and not isfile("PulseHub/texpack/" .. (string.lower(arg) .. ("_" .. (item .. ("_v1." .. item.ext))))) then
                      value[#value + 1] = "tex_" .. (arg .. ("_" .. item))
                    end
                  end
                  __pulseData.prefetch(value)
                end
              end
              local take = __pulseData.take("tex_" .. (arg .. ("_" .. arg2)))
              if take then
                writefile(text2, value.decode(take))
              end
            end
            local value2 = getcustomasset(text2)
            if (type(value2) == "string") and (#value2 > 0) then
              value.assets[text] = value2
            end
          end)
          return value.assets[text]
        end
        value.variant = function(Name, arg, tile)
          local item = value.made[Name]
          if not (item and item.Parent) then
            item = Instance.new("MaterialVariant")
            item.Name = "PulseTP_" .. Name.Name
            item.BaseMaterial = Name
            item.Parent = value.MS
            value.made[Name] = item
          end
          local asset = value.asset(value.cfg.pack, arg)
          if asset and (item.ColorMap ~= asset) then
            item.ColorMap = asset
          end
          item:SetAttribute("PulseKey", arg)
          item.StudsPerTile = math.clamp((tonumber(value.cfg.scale) or 4) * (tile.tile[arg] or 1), 0.5, 32)
          return item
        end
        value.eligible = function(IsA)
          if not IsA:IsA("BasePart") or IsA:IsA("Terrain") then
            return false
          end
          if (IsA.Transparency >= 0.95) or (IsA.MaterialVariant ~= "") then
            return false
          end
          local CurrentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera
          if CurrentCamera and IsA:IsDescendantOf(CurrentCamera) then
            return false
          end
          if string.sub(IsA.Name, 1, 5) == "Pulse" then
            return false
          end
          if IsA:IsA("MeshPart") and (IsA.TextureID ~= "") then
            return false
          end
          local Parent = IsA.Parent
          while Parent and (Parent ~= workspace) do
            if Parent:IsA("Model") and Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
              return false
            end
            if ((Parent:IsA("Tool") or Parent:IsA("Accessory")) or (Parent.Name == "CoinContainer")) or (string.sub(Parent.Name, 1, 5) == "Pulse") then
              return false
            end
            Parent = Parent.Parent
          end
          return true
        end
        value.applyPart = function(Material, map)
          if value.parts[Material] then
            return
          end
          local item = map.map[Material.Material.Name]
          if not item or not value.eligible(Material) then
            return
          end
          local item2 = value.made[Material.Material]
          if not (item2 and item2.Parent) then
            item2 = value.variant(Material.Material, item, map)
          end
          local value = {mat = Material.Material, color = Material.Color}
          value.parts[Material] = value
          Material.MaterialVariant = item2.Name
          if value.cfg.mcColors and map.neutral[item] then
            Material.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
          end
        end
        value.restorePart = function(MaterialVariant, color)
          pcall(function()
            if MaterialVariant.Parent then
              if string.sub(MaterialVariant.MaterialVariant, 1, 8) == "PulseTP_" then
                MaterialVariant.MaterialVariant = ""
              end
              MaterialVariant.Color = color.color
            end
          end)
        end
        value.clear = function()
          value.gen = (value.gen or 0) + 1
          table.clear(value.queue)
          for item, item2 in pairs(value.parts) do
            value.restorePart(item, item2)
          end
          value.parts = {}
          for item3, item4 in pairs(value.made) do
            pcall(function()
              item4:Destroy()
            end)
          end
          value.made = {}
          if value.oldUse ~= nil then
            pcall(function()
              value.MS.Use2022Materials = value.oldUse
            end)
            value.oldUse = nil
          end
        end
        value.apply = function()
          value.last = value.cfg.pack
          value.clear()
          local item = value.PACKS[value.cfg.pack]
          if not item then
            return
          end
          if value.oldUse == nil then
            value.oldUse = value.MS.Use2022Materials
            pcall(function()
              value.MS.Use2022Materials = true
            end)
          end
          local gen = value.gen
          task.spawn(function()
            local GetDescendants = workspace:GetDescendants()
            for index = 1, #GetDescendants do
              if (value.gen ~= gen) or not item[1][item[3]]() then
                return
              end
              local item = GetDescendants[index]
              if item:IsA("BasePart") then
                pcall(value.applyPart, item, item)
              end
              if (index % 600) == 0 then
                task.wait()
              end
            end
          end)
        end
        value.refreshColors = function()
          local item = value.PACKS[value.cfg.pack]
          if not item then
            return
          end
          for item2, item3 in pairs(value.parts) do
            pcall(function()
              if item2.Parent then

                end
              end
            end)
          end
        end
        value.rescale = function()

        value.number = function(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4)
          arg = tonumber(arg)
          if (((arg == nil) or (arg ~= arg)) or (arg == math.huge)) or (arg == -math.huge) then
            arg = arg2
          end
          return math.clamp(arg, arg3, arg4)
        end
        value.validate = function()
          if value.recipes[value.kind] == nil then
            value.kind = "Snow"
          end
          if value.qualities[value.quality] == nil then
            value.quality = "Balanced"
          end
          for item, item2 in pairs(value.limits) do
            value[item] = value.number(value[item], item2[1], item2[2], item2[3])
          end
          for item3, item4 in ipairs(value.colourFields) do
            if typeof(value[item4]) ~= "Color3" then
              value[item4] = value.defaults[item4]
            end
          end
        end
        value.mapRoots = function()
          local clock = os.clock()
          if (value.rootsAt and ((clock - value.rootsAt) < 5)) and value.roots then
            return value.roots
          end
          local value = {}
          for item, item2 in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
            if (item2.ClassName == "Model") and (item2:FindFirstChild("CoinContainer") or string.find(item2.Name, "Lobby", 1, true)) then
              value[#value + 1] = item2
            end
          end
          value.roots, value.rootsAt = value, clock
          return value
        end
        value.invisible = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
        value.splashes = {}
        value.filter = function(self)
          local value = {self}
          for item, item2 in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
            if item2.Character then
              value[#value + 1] = item2.Character
            end
          end
          for item3 in pairs(value.invisible) do
            if item3.Parent then
              value[#value + 1] = item3
            end
          end
          local new = RaycastParams.new()
          new.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
          new.FilterDescendantsInstances = value
          new.IgnoreWater = true
          pcall(function()
            new.RespectCanCollide = true
          end)
          value.params = new
        end
        value.cast = function(arg, arg2)
          if not value.params then
            return nil, false
          end
          for index = 1, 6 do
            local value, value2 = pcall(function()
              return workspace:Raycast(arg, arg2, value.params)
            end)
            if not value then
              return nil, false
            end
            if not value2 then
              return nil, true
            end
            local value3 = value2.Instance
            if value3:IsA("BasePart") and (value3.Transparency >= 0.95) then
              value.invisible[value3] = true
              pcall(function()
                value.params:AddToFilter(value3)
              end)
            else
              return value2, true
            end
          end
          return nil, true
        end
        value.volume = function(arg, arg2)

          instance.CastShadow, instance.Transparency = false, 1

          instance.Parent = arg
          return instance
        end

        value.envStep = function()
          local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
          local ClockTime = Lighting.ClockTime
          local value = math.clamp((ClockTime - 5.5) / 1.5, 0, 1) * math.clamp((19.5 - ClockTime) / 1.5, 0, 1)
          local OutdoorAmbient = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient
          local value2 = ((OutdoorAmbient.R + OutdoorAmbient.G) + OutdoorAmbient.B) / 3
          local clamp = math.clamp(1 - (value2 / 0.55), 0, 1)
          value.envDark = math.max(1 - value, clamp * 0.8)
        end
        value.audioBuild = function()

              instance:Play()
            end)
            value.voices[#value.voices + 1] = {sound = instance, eq = instance2, spec = item2, level = 0}
          end
        end
        value.build = function(self)
          value.stop(true)
          value.camera, value.character = self, item16.Character
          value.builtKind, value.builtQuality, value.builtSound = value.kind, value.quality, value.sound
          value.folder = Instance.new("Folder")
          value.folder.Name = "PulseWeather_" .. tostring(item4)
          value.folder.Parent = self
          local item = value.recipes[value.kind]
          for item2, item3 in ipairs(item.layers) do
            local value = (item3.noShelter and 1) or 3
            local value2 = (value + 1) / 2
            for index = 1, value do
              for index2 = 1, value do
                local volume = value.volume(value.folder, "WeatherVolume" .. (item2 .. ("_" .. (index .. index2))))
                local instance = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
                instance.Name = "WeatherParticles"
                instance.Enabled, instance.Rate = false, 0
                instance.LockedToPart, instance.VelocityInheritance = false, 0
                instance.EmissionDirection = (item3.lift and Enum.NormalId.Top) or Enum.NormalId.Bottom
                pcall(function()
                  instance.Shape = Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Box
                  instance.ShapeStyle = Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeStyle.Volume
                  instance.ShapeInOut = Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeInOut.Outward

                instance.Parent = volume
                value.nodes[#value.nodes + 1] = {
                  part = volume,
                  emitter = instance,
                  blocked = true,
                  layer = item3,
                  grid = value,
                  gx = index2 - value2,
                  gz = index - value2,
                  slots = value * value,
                  seed = math.random() * 6.2832
                }
              end
            end
          end
          if item.ripples and value.ripples then
            local WeatherSplashes = value.volume(value.folder, "WeatherSplashes")
            WeatherSplashes.CFrame = CFrame.new()
            for index3 = 1, value.qualities[value.quality].pool do
              local instance2 = Instance.new("Attachment")

              instance3.Parent = instance2

              instance4.Enabled, instance4.Rate, instance4.LockedToPart = true, 0, false

        value.flutter = NumberSequence.new({
          NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0),
          NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.14, 0.75),
          NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.29, -0.55),
          NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.43, 0.65),
          NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.57, -0.7),

          NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.86, -0.6),

        value.stretchSquash = function()
          local value = (item15.ui and tonumber(item15.ui.stretch)) or 0
          if value <= 0 then
            return 0
          end
          local max = math.max(0.1, 1 - ((value / 100) * 0.6))
          return math.floor((-math.log(max, 2) * 100) + 0.5) / 100
        end
        value.squashFor = function(flutter, arg)
          if flutter.flutter then
            return value.flutter
          end
          return NumberSequence.new(math.clamp(arg, -3, 3))
        end
        value.spinFor = function(Rotation, rot, arg)
          local value = rot.rot and not ((arg > 0) and not rot.flutter)
          Rotation.Rotation = (value and NumberRange.new(0, 360)) or NumberRange.new(0)
          Rotation.RotSpeed = (value and NumberRange.new(-rot.rot, rot.rot)) or NumberRange.new(0)
        end
        value.applySquash = function(self)
          value.squash = self
          for item, item2 in ipairs(value.nodes) do
            pcall(function()
              item2.emitter.Squash = value.squashFor(item2.layer, self)
              value.spinFor(item2.emitter, item2.layer, self)
            end)
          end
        end
        value.fadeSeq = function(self)
          return NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.1, 1 - self), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.78, 1 - self), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})
        end
        value.pulseSeq = function(self)
          local total = 1 - self
          return NumberSequence.new({
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.1, total),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.3, 1 - (self * 0.15)),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, total + ((1 - total) * 0.9)),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.68, total),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.85, 1 - (self * 0.25)),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)
          })
        end
        value.pulseSize = function(arg, arg2)
          local value = (arg + arg2) * 0.5
          return NumberSequence.new({
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.12, value),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.3, arg2 * 0.45),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, arg2),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.72, arg * 0.5),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.88, value * 0.8),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0)
          })
        end
        value.layerRate = function(from)
          local value = value.amount / 100
          if from.from and (value < from.from) then
            return 0
          end
          local rate = from.rate
          local total = rate[1] + ((rate[2] - rate[1]) * value)
          local rate2 = value.qualities[value.quality].rate
          return (total * rate2) * (((value.effectiveRadius or value.radius) / 30) ^ 2)
        end
        value.configure = function()
          local item = value.recipes[value.kind]
          local value = value.opacity / 100
          local value2 = value.speed / 100
          local item2 = value[item.colour]
          value.effectiveRadius = value.radius
          local envDark = value.envDark
          for item3, item4 in ipairs(value.nodes) do
            local layer = item4.layer
            local value3 = ((value.effectiveRadius * 2) * layer.reach) / item4.grid
            item4.tile = value3
            item4.part.Size = Vector3.new(value3, layer.h, value3)
            item4.rate = value.layerRate(layer) / item4.slots
            local emitter = item4.emitter
            emitter.Texture = value2[layer.tex]
            local value4 = layer.col or item2
            local value5 = layer.tint or 0.2
            local value6 = (layer.col2 and value[layer.col2]) or item2
            if layer.fire then
              emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new({ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, value6:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(255, 246, 210), 0.65)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.35, value6), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, value6:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(140, 20, 6), 0.65))})
            elseif layer.pulse then
              emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new({ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, value4:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.35)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, value4)})
            else
              emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(value4:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), value5), value4)
            end
            emitter.LightInfluence = layer.light or 0.3
            emitter.LightEmission = math.clamp((layer.glow or 0) * (0.4 + (0.6 * envDark)), 0, 1)
            emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(layer.life[1] / value2, layer.life[2] / value2)
            emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(layer.speed[1] * value2, layer.speed[2] * value2)
            local value7, value8 = layer.size[1] * value.scale, layer.size[2] * value.scale
            local value9, value10 = (value7 + value8) * 0.5, (value8 - value7) * 0.5
            if layer.pulse then
              emitter.Size = value.pulseSize(value7, value8)
            elseif layer.fire then
              emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, value9, value10), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.7, value9 * 0.75, value10 * 0.7), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, value9 * 0.2, 0)})
            else
              emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, value9 * 0.9, value10), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.2, value9, value10), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, value9 * 0.92, value10)})
            end
            local clamp = math.clamp((value * (layer.alpha or 1)) * (0.9 + (0.2 * envDark)), 0, 1)
            if layer.pulse or layer.flicker then
              emitter.Transparency = value.pulseSeq(clamp)
            else
              emitter.Transparency = value.fadeSeq(clamp)
            end
            emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(layer.spread or 5, layer.spread or 5)
            emitter.Drag = layer.drag or 0
            local stretchSquash = value.stretchSquash()
            value.spinFor(emitter, layer, stretchSquash)
            emitter.Orientation = Enum.ParticleOrientation.FacingCamera
            pcall(function()
              emitter.Squash = value.squashFor(layer, stretchSquash)
            end)
            pcall(function()
              emitter.FlipbookLayout = Enum.ParticleFlipbookLayout.None
            end)
            emitter.Enabled = true
          end
          local Lerp = item2:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.5)
          for item5, item6 in ipairs(value.splashes) do
            local ripple = item6.ripple
            ripple.Texture = value2.ring
            ripple.Color = ColorSequence.new(Lerp)
            ripple.LightInfluence, ripple.LightEmission = 0.5, 0.25
            ripple.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.45, 0.6)
            ripple.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top
            ripple.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.01, 0.02)
            ripple.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(0, 0)
            ripple.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
            ripple.Drag = 0
            ripple.Size = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.45, 0.8 * value.scale), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1.2 * value.scale)})
            ripple.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.15, 1 - math.clamp(value * 0.5, 0.15, 0.5)), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})
            ripple.Rotation = NumberRange.new(-180, 180)
            ripple.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(0)
            ripple.Orientation = Enum.ParticleOrientation.VelocityPerpendicular
            local spray = item6.spray
            spray.Texture = value2.splash
            spray.Color = ColorSequence.new(Lerp)
            spray.LightInfluence, spray.LightEmission = 0.5, 0.4
            spray.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.25, 0.45)
            spray.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Top
            spray.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1.6)
            spray.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(20, 20)
            spray.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -6, 0)

              end

              return (Dot * (math.sin((1 - arg2) * acos) / sin)) + (arg * (math.sin(arg2 * acos) / sin))

        paintTiles.loadPhotos = function()
          if paintTiles.photoAsset == nil then
            paintTiles.photoAsset = false
            pcall(function()
              if (not paintTiles.ATLAS or (type(writefile) ~= "function")) or (type(getcustomasset) ~= "function") then
                return
              end
              if ((type(isfolder) == "function") and (type(makefolder) == "function")) and not isfolder("PulseHub") then
                makefolder("PulseHub")
              end
              if not ((type(isfile) == "function") and isfile("PulseHub/sky_fx_v6.jpg")) then
                writefile("PulseHub/sky_fx_v6.jpg", item3(paintTiles.ATLAS))
              end
              local PulseHubSky_fx_v6Jpg = getcustomasset("PulseHub/sky_fx_v6.jpg")
              if (type(PulseHubSky_fx_v6Jpg) == "string") and (#PulseHubSky_fx_v6Jpg > 0) then
                paintTiles.photoAsset = PulseHubSky_fx_v6Jpg
              end
            end)
          end
          if not paintTiles.photoAsset then
            return
          end
          for item, item2 in ipairs(paintTiles.tiles or {}) do
            item2.img.Image = paintTiles.photoAsset
            item2.img.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new(((item - 1) % 4) * 256, math.floor((item - 1) / 4) * 128)
            item2.img.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(256, 128)
            item2.img.Visible = true
          end

        paintTiles.scene = function(self)
          if not paintTiles.sceneSaved then
            paintTiles.sceneSaved = {}
            for item, item2 in ipairs(paintTiles.order) do
              paintTiles.sceneSaved[item2] = paintTiles.cfg[item2].on
            end
          end
          local value = {}
          for item3, item4 in ipairs(self or {}) do
            value[item4] = true
          end
          for item5, item6 in ipairs(paintTiles.order) do
            local item7 = value[item6]
            local equal = value[item6] == true
            if item7 and (paintTiles.cfg[item6].on ~= equal) then
              item7.Set(equal)
            end
          end
          if paintTiles.paintTiles then
            pcall(paintTiles.paintTiles)
          end
        end
        paintTiles.sceneEnd = function()
          local sceneSaved = paintTiles.sceneSaved
          paintTiles.sceneSaved = nil
          if not sceneSaved then
            return
          end
          for item, item2 in ipairs(paintTiles.order) do
            local item3 = value[item2]
            local equal = sceneSaved[item2] == true
            if item3 and (paintTiles.cfg[item2].on ~= equal) then
              item3.Set(equal)
            end
          end
          if paintTiles.paintTiles then
            pcall(paintTiles.paintTiles)
          end
        end
